jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:

**Executive Assistant & Project coordinator**

**Status:** Part-Time (25-30 hours/week, Monday–Friday)

**Pay:** $20.00- $22.00/hour, depending on experience

**Benefits:** Employees working 30 or more hours per week are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, paid holidays, PTO, and 401(k) with company matching. Employees working fewer than 30 hours per week are eligible for sick time only

**Location:** Brea, CA

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly organized, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant to support our company owners with administrative tasks, research, and various projects. The ideal candidate can manage multiple priorities, communicate effectively, work independently, and follow tasks through to completion with minimal direction.

We are looking for a natural problem-solver who takes initiative, embraces technology and AI, and continually looks for smarter ways to work.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Manage calendars, meetings, and travel arrangements.
* Create presentations, PowerPoint slide decks, spreadsheets, and business documents.
* Conduct research and assist with company projects and new clinic location setups.
* Organize tasks, track deadlines, coordinate projects, and ensure follow-through.
* Manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Communicate professionally and proactively with internal and external contacts.
* Identify problems, find solutions, and take initiative without constant direction.
* Utilize AI tools to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and support research and communication.
* Maintain organized records and handle confidential information appropriately.

Requirements:

**Job Requirements**

* Previous experience in an executive assistant, administrative, or similar role preferred.
* Exceptional organizational, multitasking, and time management skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Resourceful, proactive, and able to work independently.
* Strong follow-through and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Comfortable learning new software and navigating multiple technology platforms.
* Strong AI proficiency, including effective prompt writing and the ability to apply AI tools to everyday business tasks.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, and discretion with confidential information.

**Technology & AI Proficiency**

AI and technology are important to this role. Candidates should be comfortable using AI tools to improve efficiency, support research and writing, organize information, and streamline administrative processes. The ability to create effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated results for accuracy, and use technology to identify smarter ways of working is essential.

**Resourcefulness is our number one priority.** We want someone who takes ownership, anticipates needs, solves problems, and gets things done without needing constant direction. The right candidate is organized, adaptable, an excellent communicator, and always looking for ways to work smarter and more efficiently.

jobs.title: Operations Project Coordinator II
jobs.description:

---------------------

**GFT** is seeking a **Project Coordinator** to join our Shared Services team in Long Beach, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, requiring regular attendance in Long Beach, CA.

**What you’ll be challenged to do:**

The Operations Project Coordinator II provides project management, administrative, and accounting support to project teams, particularly for large, complex, and high-risk clients/projects, in collaboration with Project Accounting.

**In this capacity, the successful candidate will be responsible for the following:**

jobs.title: Project Coordinator – Custom Design Projects
jobs.description:
**Project Coordinator — Custom Design Projects**  
**Dorell Fabric Studio | Fountain Valley, CA**

**Love Design, But Don't Want to Sell It?**

If you've ever thought, *“I love design, but I don't want to be the one selling it,”* this might be exactly the role you've been looking for.

Maybe you're the person who loves organizing, juggling a dozen moving parts, solving problems, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks. You appreciate beautiful fabrics, custom window treatments, and thoughtfully designed spaces—but what really satisfies you is **making things happen**.

At Dorell, our Design Consultants work with clients to create beautiful solutions for their homes. As a Project Coordinator, you'll be the person who helps bring those plans to life—coordinating the details, the people, and the process that turn a great design into a beautifully completed project.

**What You'll Do**

You'll help manage custom window treatment and related design projects from the early planning stages through fabrication, delivery, installation, and completion.

You'll work closely with the Design Consultant responsible for each project, along with clients, fabric suppliers, independent workrooms, installers, and other partners, to make sure all the moving pieces come together and each project progresses smoothly.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **Keep projects moving.** Track multiple projects through their various stages, knowing what's been completed, what's outstanding, and what needs to happen next.
* **Bring the details together.** Help gather pricing, measurements, specifications, fabric information, workroom requirements, and other details needed to prepare accurate proposals and orders.
* **Catch things before they become problems.** Review project information for completeness and accuracy, identify missing pieces, and proactively follow up before they cause delays or mistakes.
* **Coordinate the people involved.** Work with Design Consultants, vendors, workrooms, installers, and clients to make sure everyone has the information they need, when they need it.
* **Keep everyone informed.** Communicate proactively about project status, timelines, next steps, and changes so clients and colleagues aren't left wondering what's happening.
* **Follow through to the finish.** Help coordinate production, quality checks, delivery, installation, and the resolution of any issues along the way.
* **Help us get better.** Identify opportunities to improve workflows, communication, documentation, and systems as our custom design business grows.

You'll be juggling multiple projects, each with its own details, deadlines, people, and priorities. If that sounds energizing rather than overwhelming, you may be exactly who we're looking for.

**A True Partnership With Our Design Consultants**

Our Design Consultants work with clients to understand their vision, explore possibilities, and develop solutions that reflect their style, needs, and budget.

**The Design Consultant owns the client relationship and design direction.**

**You own the operational progression that turns that design direction into a beautifully completed project.**

That doesn't mean waiting for someone to tell you what to do next. You'll know where projects stand, anticipate what's needed, follow up, and keep things moving.

You'll also become another trusted point of contact for our clients—someone who knows their project, communicates clearly, and gives them confidence that the details are being handled.

Together, you and the Design Consultant help deliver an experience that's as thoughtful and professional as the finished result.

**You'll Probably Love This Role If You...**

* Are naturally organized and enjoy keeping lots of moving parts straight.
* Get satisfaction from checking things off, solving puzzles, and making progress.
* Notice details other people sometimes miss.
* Can juggle multiple projects and changing priorities without losing your sense of direction.
* Communicate clearly, warmly, and professionally—with clients as well as colleagues and vendors.
* Follow through without needing someone to remind you.
* Are comfortable asking questions, tracking down answers, and taking initiative.
* Enjoy working with people who bring different skills and perspectives to a project.
* Appreciate beautiful design, craftsmanship, and the care that goes into custom work.
* Like improving systems and finding better ways to get things done.

Most importantly, you care about the outcome. You don't just want a project marked complete—you want it completed **well**.

**What Experience Will Help You Succeed?**

You may already have experience coordinating projects, managing orders, scheduling production, or keeping complex work organized.

Experience in custom window treatments, drapery, interior design, furniture, cabinetry, construction, or another made-to-order business would certainly be valuable.

But you don't necessarily need to come from our industry.

We're equally interested in someone who has developed strong project coordination skills elsewhere and is excited about applying them in a creative, design-focused environment.

What matters most is that you bring:

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Experience managing multiple tasks, projects, or orders simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* The ability to work independently and take ownership of follow-through.
* Comfort using and learning project-management applications and everyday business technology to keep work organized and moving forward.
* A practical, solutions-oriented approach to problems.
* The ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, clients, and outside partners.

jobs.title: Leadership Development Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join LA’s BEST as a Leadership Development Program Coordinator to Grow Leaders and Inspire the Next Generation!**

  

**About LA’s BEST**

LA’s BEST is a public/private partnership between the City of Los Angeles, the Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD), and the private sector, working together to provide safe, engaging, and enriching afterschool programming for elementary school students. Established 38 years ago, LA’s BEST serves children in neighborhoods with the greatest needs but the fewest resources, ensuring access to meaningful learning experiences beyond the school day.

Through this public-private partnership, LAUSD operates the program, the City of Los Angeles provides crucial public support, and the nonprofit entity advocates for funding and resources. This shared commitment allows LA’s BEST to provide high-quality enrichment activities that nurture academic growth, social-emotional well-being for students while also supporting working families across Los Angeles.

At LA’s BEST, we believe that diversity fuels innovation, creativity, and success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every individual's unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are valued and celebrated. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, ages, religions, and socioeconomic backgrounds. Join us in our mission to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to thrive and contribute their best work. Your voice matters, and we invite you to bring your authentic self to our team.

**Job Overview & Responsibilities**

Reporting to the Director of Leadership Development, the **Leadership Development Program Coordinator** supports the design, coordination, and implementation of training programs that enhance staff leadership, youth development competencies, and professional growth at LA’s BEST. This position collaborates with internal teams and field staff to facilitate in-person and digital training, provide coaching and mentorship, and ensure alignment with the organization's mission and values for over one hundred staff members. The **Leadership Development Program Coordinator** also manages training logistics, supports curriculum development, and contributes to continuous quality improvement efforts across 200+ sites, strengthening the leadership pipeline and professional capacity of site staff at LA’s BEST. Core responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

Training Program Development & Facilitation (approximately 50%):

* Design, develop, and deliver engaging in-person and digital training programs that enhance leadership skills and youth development competencies for LA’s BEST Site Coordinators and Area Program Supervisors (APS).
* Ensure training content aligns with LA’s BEST’s mission, values, and youth development principles.
* Facilitate workshops, coaching sessions, and hands-on learning experiences to support staff professional growth and program quality.
* Collaborate with leadership and field staff to assess training needs and develop targeted learning opportunities.
* Develop and curate training materials, presentations, and digital learning content for online platforms.

  

Staff Coaching & Professional Development Support (approximately 25%):

* Mentor and provide ongoing coaching to Leadership Development APSs (supporting over 200 sites), equipping them with the skills to train and support Site Coordinators and APSs effectively.
* Implement systems of accountability and quality control to ensure staff development initiatives lead to measurable improvements in performance and program effectiveness.
* Partner with internal teams to identify best practices and ensure alignment across all professional development efforts.

  

Program Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement (approximately 15%):

* Assist with the logistics and execution of leadership development programs, including communication systems, scheduling, and training event coordination.
* Collaborate with cross-departmental teams to integrate leadership development efforts into broader organizational initiatives.
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners to enhance training offerings and support ongoing professional learning opportunities for Site Coordinators and APSs.
* Represent LA’s BEST’s values, youth development principles, and technical assistance (TA) strategies in all training and leadership development initiatives.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support the organization’s mission and goals.

  

Data Assessment & Continuous Improvement (approximately 10%):

* Track training participation, engagement, and effectiveness to assess program impact and identify areas for improvement.
* Utilize data and feedback from staff to refine training programs and ensure continuous learning and development.
* Support the development of reports and assessments related to training effectiveness, learning outcomes, and leadership growth.
* Stay informed on industry trends, youth development research, and training methodologies to enhance the quality of professional development programs.

  

**Core Competencies**

* Ability to maintain regular and consistent attendance.
* Strong ability to develop and deliver engaging in-person and digital training programs.
* Knowledge of youth development principles and best practices in leadership training.
* Ability to create interactive learning experiences that align with LA’s BEST mission and values.
* Proficiency in instructional design and adult learning methodologies.
* Skilled in mentoring and coaching staff to enhance leadership skills and program quality.
* Strong understanding of professional development strategies and leadership pipeline development.
* Strong relationship-building skills to collaborate with internal

jobs.description:
Please go to http://www.hacla.org/careers for details of this position and to apply.
  
  
**Special Note:** The posted salary is an estimate of the potential annual pay. Final offer will be dependent on qualifications and experience.
  
  
\*\*\*Position is open until filled\*\*\*

**SUMMARY:** Under general direction this position is responsible to plan, organize, coordinate, implement and evaluate one or more assigned functions or program areas such as digital inclusion & literacy, child care, youth development, fund raising and sponsor identification, community and cultural arts, recreational services, family and senior services, or other assigned functions; conducts administrative studies and analysis to solve problems of budget, organization, program, procedure, employee utilization, capital projects or equipment; service coordination, develops and recommends program guidelines, standards, procedures, policies and protocols; develops schedules, priorities, reports and standards for achieving program goals.
  
  
This position will oversee the utilization and programming of the Housing Authority’s Computer Labs and other public spaces to be centers for learning, engagement, wellness and positive activity; develop and implement best practice programmatic and capital investments to improve functionality and outcomes; seek out and nurture partnerships with other organizations to leverage resources and bring consistent, meaningful programs and opportunities to residents of public and affordable housing. This position will participate in a team focused on people-based strategies to impact the economic, health and educational trajectories of Housing Authority residents.

**PRINICIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES****:**
  
Meets and contacts a wide variety of community partners promoting and implementing programs for Housing Authority clients. Must also assist the staff of Housing Authority in establishing and maintaining program services. Acts as a liaison for the Housing Authority; meets with representatives of various agencies, community groups, and service providers in coordinating services provided to Housing Authority clients, confers with staff on program problems and resolves issues and problems; prepares and reviews reports on the effectiveness of program activities and prepares executive briefings, special and annual reports. Participate with a variety of Housing Authority committees, study groups, and task forces; attend a variety of meetings including staff and departmental meetings. Participates in collaborative meetings and acts as a liaison to communicate with partners and HACLA. Prepare and make oral and written presentations before Board of Commissioners, committees, community groups, professional groups and other agency bodies to coordinate, improve, and stimulate interest in the program and to secure financial support. May supervise and evaluate the performance of assigned staff; prepare and/or oversee the preparation of training, operational manuals, educational materials and information of assigned program areas; also be able to perform related duties as required.

Requires knowledge of principles and practices of public and business administration, social services programs, including organization, personnel and fiscal management, and program management; statistical and research methods;; oral and written communication skills; applicable sections of federal, state and local rules, regulations, and laws; technical aspects of assigned functions and program areas; public speaking; budget preparation and administration; and supervision. Knowledge of community outreach and engagement is preferred with experience working with large collaborations and/or contract teams.

jobs.title: Faculty Support and Academic Program Coordinator, Office of Faculty Support and Academic Success Program
jobs.description:
Founded in 1896, the Gould School of Law has a distinguished past built on the principles of equity and excellence, and the courage to break new ground. USC first introduced legal education in Southern California. Today, the Law School continues to make history through its philosophy of innovation and through its people. USC Gould cultivates analytical ability, ethical values, and a spirit of collegiality that prepare students for meaningful careers benefiting society. It was one of the first law schools to engage students in clinical programs and remains a leader in experiential education.

The Gould School of Law is seeking to hire a Faculty Support Coordinator to join the Office of Faculty Support and support the Academic Success Program. This position will report to the Director of Faculty Support, and will assist a number of faculty with their research and teaching needs. The number of faculty assigned may vary throughout the year

**ATTENTION:** This position is full-time, benefits-eligible, and 1-year fixed term. Applicants must upload a cover letter and a resume to be considered for this position.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Preferred Education: Bachelor's degree in legal studies
* Preferred Experience: Experience in higher education

**Job Accountabilities:**

  

This position involves a variety of administrative tasks that include, but are not limited to, the following:

**50% Faculty Support**

  

* Directly completes work assignments from professors, including scanning and making photocopies, drafting and formatting letters of recommendation for students, proofreading and editing documents, ordering supplies, answering incoming calls and emails, managing and coordinating schedules.
* Helps prepare course materials, coordinates exams, takes class attendance, assists in the ordering of textbooks and additional resources, organizes and edits PowerPoint presentations, spreadsheets, and classroom handouts.
* Posts assignments, announcements, and readings to Brightspace, records grades, releases class recordings, and oversees other relevant course content.
* Arranges travel and parking reservations for faculty and guest speakers.
* Processes reimbursement requests for faculty travel and other university expenses.
* Sorts and sends mail, letters, and packages.
* Assists in event planning, including reserving meeting spaces, ordering catering, setting up rooms, coordinating speaking engagements for law professors, and other logistical needs.
* Lends classroom support to faculty to ensure that they know how to operate audio-visual equipment. Helps troubleshoot any IT issues.
* Files and/or transcribes legal documents.
* Will assist with both final exam administration and proctoring at the end of the Fall and Spring semesters and commencement each year.
* Perform other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.

**50% Academic Success Program (ASP):**

Gould’s ASP is a comprehensive program that assists JD students from admission to law school through admission to the bar. This means that ASP has programming, communications, events, and services on a 12-month schedule. The ASP is staffed by its director and associate director (both of whom are Gould faculty members), six ASP Fellows (who are upper division law students), and two Alumni Bar Coaches (who are recent Gould graduates). The program looks forward to welcoming a dedicated Faculty Support Coordinator to help with many tasks, including but not limited to those listed below. There will be other duties related to the program that are assigned or requested on an ad hoc basis and as the program changes.

The ASP Support Coordinator will also work with the faculty to create systems to make all of the ASP administrative tasks more routine and efficient, including developing ASP calendaring systems, tracking student communications, and creating instructions for how to complete required administrative tasks.

The ASP Support Coordinator will deal with students and with sensitive student data (including GPA data). As such, the ASP Support Coordinator must be highly respectful of confidentiality and privacy concerns.

It will be important for the ASP Support Coordinator to be present, on-campus dependably on at least three days per week, and on other days as needed. For example, the ASP Support Coordinator will be expected to be on campus on ASP workshop days, and during summer programs including the simulated bar exam (early July), Gould Preview (early-to-mid August), and Orientation (mid-August).

The administrative responsibilities of the ASP Support Coordinator include both those listed above under Faculty Support and the following, which is a non-exhaustive list:

  

* Creating, updating, and disseminating flyers and other publicity to promote ASP events
* Scheduling rooms and communications with other departments (often having to reschedule rooms at last minute because of double-booked events)
* Ordering and delivering food for ASP events and workshops
* Creating and administering surveys for a variety of purposes including surveys to evaluate the ASP’s events, workshops, courses, and other programs
* Updating content and posting announcements on the ASP Brightspace page
* Coordinating with ASP Fellows, alumni bar coaches, and student and alumni volunteers on events, workshops, and projects
* Outreach to other faculty to coordinate teaching schedules, reading assignments, etc. for Gould Preview and other ASP programs
* Organizing and distributing materials (e.g., homework and readings) to students through

* Communicating with students and prospective students by email and in person, including responding to routine questions from students and alumni
* Working with Gould’s Events team on ASP events and workshops
* Updating regular and ongoing monthly (and during spring and summer, weekly) email communications for students and recent graduates

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About IW Group**

IW Group is the leading multicultural advertising and marketing agency with offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and New York. Named **Ad Age’s 2025 Multicultural Agency of the Year** and recognized by **PRWeek** for Best in Multicultural Marketing, IW Group produces culture-shaping campaigns for global and national brands.

IW Group drives impactful work by blending storytelling, cultural insight, and innovation to achieve measurable results. We represent multiple brands and deliver distinctive multicultural and cross-generational campaigns.

**The Role**

We’re seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Post Production Coordinator to join our Production team. Working closely with the Post Production Producer, you’ll support all facets of post production across multiple clients—from editorial and finishing to versioning, translation, trafficking, and final delivery.

You’ll help keep projects moving, assets organized, and teams aligned so every deliverable reaches the right destination, on time and to specification. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who thrives in a fast-paced creative environment and wants to deepen their understanding of agency post production and multicultural content.

**What You’ll Do**

* Support the Post Production Producer with project schedules, status updates, production documentation, and day-to-day coordination across multiple client projects.
* Coordinate voiceover recording sessions with talent agencies, recording studios, voiceover talent, language coaches, and internal teams, including scheduling, session logistics, and follow-up on audio deliverables.
* Assist with SAG-AFTRA talent and non-union talent administration, including talent contract requests, talent estimate request forms, session reports, completion reports, and related documentation.
* Maintain accurate talent records and assist with tracking usage terms, expiration dates, renewals, and associated talent costs.
* Support production budgeting and administration, including vendor estimates, talent estimates, purchase orders (POs), invoices, and project expense tracking.
* Coordinate with editors, motion designers, audio teams, and external post-production vendors to track assets, revisions, schedules, and finishing milestones.
* Maintain deliverable matrices and version trackers covering different formats, cutdowns, languages, graphics, legal copy, and platform requirements.
* Coordinate translation and localization workflows with language partners and internal reviewers, including scripts, voiceover, subtitles, captions, and on-screen text; track approvals and implementation.
* Organize review links, consolidate feedback, and track creative, client, and legal approvals to ensure teams are working from the correct versions.
* Support quality control (QC) by reviewing picture, sound, runtimes, captions, graphics, spelling, approved copy, file naming, and technical specifications; flag discrepancies for resolution.
* Assist trafficking and final delivery of approved assets to media partners, broadcasters, digital platforms, and client teams, ensuring deadlines and delivery requirements are met.
* Provide basic hands-on editing and asset preparation support as needed, including simple cuts, revisions, resizing, and formatting for various platforms.
* Maintain organized project folders, source files, final masters, production documentation, and archives to support efficient workflows and project closeout.

**What You’ll Bring**

**Education and Experience**

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in post production, production coordination, or creative project support; internships and equivalent hands-on experience will be considered.
* A degree in film, media, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Basic understanding of editorial, graphics, color, audio, finishing, and delivery workflows.

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong organization and attention to detail, with the ability to track multiple projects, versions, and deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication and a collaborative approach to working with creative teams, account teams, and vendors.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, project trackers, review platforms, and shared asset systems.
* Familiarity with video formats, codecs, resolutions, aspect ratios, frame rates, captions, and file naming conventions.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for transcription, captioning, translation, audio cleanup, and other post production tasks, with careful review for accuracy and quality.
* Ability to follow specifications, identify discrepancies, and flag questions or scheduling risks promptly.
* A proactive, dependable approach and willingness to learn new tools and workflows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and deliverables simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working with producers, account teams, creative teams, talent agencies, recording studios, and vendors.
* Experience supporting production or post-production workflows, including scheduling, tracking deliverables, maintaining project documentation, and coordinating with internal and external partners.

**Job Description:**

**Commercial Insurance Account Manager**  
  
*Please note: If this position is posted as either fully remote and/or hybrid, in accordance with company policy, individuals residing within a 50-mile radius of a branch location may be required to work onsite in a hybrid capacity as there may be occasions when on-site presence is necessary to meet specific business needs. Additionally, our remote work policy includes having a dedicated, distraction-free workspace. Remote work is not a substitute for childcare, elder care, or other personal responsibilities during working hours. To view our branch locations, please visit: ioausa.com/locations*

**About the Role:**

**We are seeking insurance professionals with 5 to 10+ years of commercial insurance experience and an active P&C license, for current and future opportunities within our Account Management career path based on experience and licensing.** ***Multiple experience levels considered, including Account Manager, Senior Account Manager and Senior Account Executive opportunities.***

The Commercial Lines Account Management team is responsible for managing and retaining client relationships, supporting new business opportunities, delivering exceptional service, and ensuring operational excellence across an assigned book of business. **Book Focus:** **Construction, Contractors**

Manage an assigned book of business by providing day-to-day client service, supporting account retention efforts, coordinating policy administration activities, and ensuring accurate and timely execution of service deliverables.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Respond to client service requests and inquiries.
* Process policy changes, endorsements, billing requests, and claims support.
* Conduct coverage analysis and assist clients with policy-related questions.
* Maintain positive client relationships through responsive service.

### **Renewal & Retention Management**

* Manage policy expirations and renewal timelines.
* Gather underwriting information and prepare renewal submissions.
* Support renewal marketing efforts and proposal development.
* Assist with account retention initiatives.

### **Operational Excellence**

* Maintain agency management systems and carrier/vendor platforms.
* Ensure account documentation is accurate and complete.
* Monitor activity and suspense systems to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Follow company policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.

### **Financial Management**

* Assist with accounts receivable monitoring and collection efforts.
* Resolve billing and payment issues as needed.

### **Professional Development**

* Maintain technical insurance knowledge and industry awareness.
* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrate company values and a commitment to client service excellence.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3+ years of account management experience or 5+ years of insurance industry experience.
* Active insurance license.
* Strong knowledge of insurance products and brokerage operations.
* Excellent customer service, communication, organizational, and analytical skills.
* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* CIC or equivalent designation preferred.

**Senior Account Manager**
==========================

**Primary Purpose**
-------------------

Manage a complex book of business while serving as a technical resource and workflow leader for the account management team. Provide guidance on complex service matters and support operational excellence across the department.

**Additional Responsibilities Beyond Account Manager**
------------------------------------------------------

### **Technical Leadership**

* Serve as a subject matter expert for insurance products, coverages, and account management processes.
* Provide guidance on complex client service, coverage, billing, and claims issues.
* Support escalation resolution and risk management discussions.

### **Team Leadership & Coordination**

* Direct daily account management workflows and priorities.
* Monitor team workloads and service standards.
* Coordinate activities to meet quality, productivity, and service expectations.
* Communicate proactively regarding workload, priorities, and operational challenges.

### **Mentorship & Development**

* Share technical expertise and best practices with team members.
* Support training and development initiatives.
* Promote process improvements and operational efficiencies.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 5+ years of account management experience or 7+ years of insurance industry experience.
* Active insurance license.
* Advanced knowledge of insurance brokerage operations.
* Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.
* CIC or equivalent designation preferred.

**Senior Account Executive**

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**The Strategic Account Manager has dual responsibility to be the primary point of contact for a select number of key customers and manage the relationship with assigned strategic accounts within the continental USA. In managing their assigned strategic accounts this person calls on the corporate headquarters of these customers or prospects, manages the overall relationship and business development strategy. The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for ensuring consistent formatting, pricing, scopes of work, terms / conditions on all quotations and contracts with the strategic accounts.**

**What We Do**

At Rain for Rent, we move water—every day. As the leading provider of temporary liquid handling solutions, we’re recognized for our systems engineering expertise, cost-effective problem solving, and the high value we deliver to organizations facing critical liquid management challenges. Our experienced teams, supported by skilled engineers, are continually redefining what customers expect from a liquid handling provider. We design innovative equipment and harness cutting-edge technology to meet the demands of the toughest environments. From water handling and irrigation to temporary liquid storage, our solutions consistently exceed customer expectations for quality and service. We are committed to completing every project safely, efficiently, on time—and done right the first time.

**To learn more about Rain for Rent please check out this short 2 minute YouTube video****here.** (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IfacXlPz9a8)

Rain for Rent employees take great pride in being part of a family-owned company with a rich and enduring legacy. For over 91 years, we’ve delivered consistent, high-quality products and services to our customers. With more than 70 locations across the U.S., Canada, and the UK, Rain for Rent remains committed to excellence. Honesty and integrity are at the core of everything we do. Our dedicated team strives to exceed expectations through exceptional service and unwavering quality.

**Summary:**

The Strategic Account Manager has dual responsibility to be the primary point of contact for a select number of key customers and manage the relationship with assigned strategic accounts within the continental USA. The primary goal of this position is to increase revenue and customer satisfaction with assigned strategic account customers by developing and executing annual account plans. In managing their assigned strategic accounts this person calls on the corporate headquarters of these customers or prospects, manages the overall relationship and business development strategy. The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for ensuring consistent formatting, pricing, scopes of work, terms / conditions on all quotations and contracts with the strategic accounts.

***\*\*Ideal candidate will have previous refinery and/or environmental sales work experience\*\****

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage strategic accounts to increase market share, profitability, and revenues.
* Prepares budgets, account plans, and succession plans for each assigned account.
* Establishes relationships up and down the chain of command for each strategic account.
* Meet or exceed assigned strategic account revenue goals.
* Work closely with Sales Representatives, Regional Sales Managers, Branch Managers, Regional Vice Presidents, and Corporate Staff to support their strategic and regional account efforts.
* Communicates account objectives for sales, and coordinates project scope of work, product and resource needs, timelines, and customer service to branch and corporate personnel.
* Ensure accounts receivable for assigned accounts do not go past 90 days (8% over 90).
* Assists in the development of marketing and training materials and contributes to development of the segment strategy including product development, brand positioning, pricing, and expansion.
* Develop new sales opportunities using creativity and resourcefulness.
* Actively leads the resolution of strategic account issues.
* Prepare written monthly reports and weekly updates on account revenues and issues.
* Increase visibility of the corporate strategic account program by attending regional meetings, sales presentations, conference calls, conferences, trade shows, conducting BB / TS and other interactive opportunities.
* Promote the company value proposition including full-service solutions.
* Attends industry events for networking and continual professional development.
* Manages travel and entertainment expenses within budget.
* Handles high stress situations and communicates calmly, concisely and professionally.
* Committed to exceeding customer expectations; is versatile and manages changing priorities.
* Actively promotes the best practice of safety and environmental standards and behaviors.
* Exhibit strong work ethic and negotiation skills.
* Other duties as assigned to support the operation.

**What We Offer**

At Rain for Rent, we take pride in taking care of our team. We offer a comprehensive benefits package and a supportive work environment where employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Our offerings include:

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Matching 401(k) retirement savings plan
* Competitive base salary
* Nine paid holidays and a generous paid time off (PTO) program
* Tuition reimbursement to support continued education
* Company-sponsored training and career development opportunities
* Pet insurance and many other valuable perks
* Strategic Account Managers are eligible for our generous annual bonus incentive
* Strategic Account Manager position is eligible for our vehicle reimbursement program

jobs.description:
**A path for every ambition.**

At HUB, we believe the best work happens when people are given real space to grow and then given the autonomy to exercise it. We power progress and protect ambition: for the clients who count on us, and equally for the people who make that possible every day.

We’re creative thinkers and determined doers, guided by values that show up in how we work together: with empathy, adaptability, accountability and a genuine commitment to one another’s success. We foster bold ideas, celebrate curiosity and share what we know. Because when people grow, the work they do grows with them.

Our purpose is deeply human: to help people navigate the world on their terms, at their speed, toward their future. We hold that same commitment to the people building careers here.

Whether you’re starting out or leveling up, you’ll find the resources to evolve, the support to take on more and a team ready to back you at every stage.

Your ambition has a home here.

**THE OPPORTUNITY:**

We are seeking an experienced Account Manager to join our Commercial Lines team. Our service team plays a vital role in ensuring our clients receive the service they need to properly manage their insurance policies. You are the facilitator of positive and effective relationships with our valued clients and partner insurance carriers.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* assists with the management of the entire account-service process
* markets to carriers
* prepares quotes and proposals
* checks policies/endorsements/audits for accuracy
* coordinates premium financing and the collection of premiums, as needed

### **WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:**

* hold a high school diploma/GED (college degree strongly preferred)
* have at least 2+ years of related insurance experience
* are currently licensed in good standing (or, willing to obtain
* have the confidence and demeanor to effectively interact with all levels within the organization
* are computer literate - Microsoft Office Suite and Outlook
* Bilingual - Fluent in Korean

The expected salary range for this position is $60-$80k depending on geographical location and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate's skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position's business line, scope and level.

**What we offer you**

We invest in your growth. HUB offers structured training, licensing support and ongoing development opportunities designed to accelerate your career.

* Competitive pay with comprehensive health benefits, retirement savings matching and company-paid life and disability plans
* Generous paid time off, paid parental leave and a wellbeing program designed to support real work/life balance
* A collaborative, high-performing culture with meaningful engagement, community impact through HUB Gives and genuine room to grow your career

**The HUB difference**

HUB International is one of North America’s largest insurance brokers, delivering risk management, insurance, employee benefits, retirement and wealth management solutions to businesses and individuals across the United States and Canada — through locally led teams backed by national expertise, giving you the agility of a local partner and the reach of a global organization.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to access our career site, complete an application, or participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact the Recruiting Team at HUBRecruiting@HUBInternational.com. **DSV - Global transport and logistics**
  
In 1976, ten independent hauliers joined forces and founded DSV in Denmark. Since then, DSV has evolved to become the world's 3rd largest supplier of global solutions within transport and logistics. Today, we add value to our customers' entire supply chain by transporting, storing, packaging, re-packaging, processing and clearing all types of goods. We work every day from our many offices in more than 80 countries to ensure a steady supply of goods to production lines, outlets, stores and consumers all over the world. Our reach is global yet our presence is local and close to our customers. Read more at www.dsv.com

As a Key Account Manager in Operations at DSV, you will be responsible for managing and growing key accounts in the transportation and logistics industry. You will work closely with clients to ensure their satisfaction and oversee the operational aspects of their shipments. You will collaborate with internal teams to provide exceptional service and meet client needs.

* Manage and grow key accounts in the transportation and logistics industry
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients
* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure client satisfaction and meet operational goals
* Oversee the operational aspects of client shipments, including transportation, warehousing, and distribution
* Develop and implement account strategies and plans
* Analyze account performance and identify opportunities for improvement
* Prepare and present reports to clients and internal teams

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software

* Master's degree in business, logistics, supply chain management, or a related field
* Experience with international logistics and customs regulations
* Experience with sales and business development
  

**Language skills**

* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
  

**Computer Literacy**

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and other relevant software
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and customer relationship management (CRM) software is preferred.

jobs.description:
* Los Angeles, California, United States
* Sales
* Experienced Professionals
* 21925

  

**Relationships That Drive Results. Success That Lasts.**
---------------------------------------------------------

Our account managers serve as the go-to contact for our customers, embodying our purpose to make construction better by being their partner for productivity, safety, and sustainability. You will manage your own portfolio of customer accounts and be given ownership to build a work schedule that best suits you and your customers. You’ll make sales by maintaining customer relationships, demonstrating our latest tools on the spot, and providing high level customer consultation.

**What You'll do**
------------------

* Building relationships – you’ll meet with customers at a moment’s notice or be actively present to capture the perfect business opportunity. You understand to create value in account(s) through long-term, profitable relationships
* Time and Territory Management (TTM) - creating a daily schedule (including presence on jobsites and client offices) to optimize client potential and sales productivity by zone territory
* Be a Hilti Champion – you’ll carry the technical knowledge to present high level customer consultations in your defined territory and represent the Hilti brand in the marketplace
* Tracking your progress – you’ll utilize Salesforce to record all the interactions you had to make a sale as reporting is a key part of this role

**What You’ll Bring**
---------------------

* High School Diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s Degree preferred or equivalent work experience
* At least three years of outside sales experience – preferably in an environment with set targets
* Hands-on attitude – you'll be demonstrating our tools to our customers, using platforms such as Salesforce to keep track of everything, and collaborate with a variety of departments
* Maintain a valid driver’s license – we'll provide you with a company car, be sure you’re ready to drive
* Excellent time and territory management skills
* Must be able to walk on construction projects, climb scaffolding, and lift as much as 65 pounds at any given time
* Work a flexible and varied schedule

**What’s In It for You**
------------------------

With Comp: Our account managers earn between $80,000 – $91,000 + up to $19,000 in bonuses for their first year if all sales goals are met. The account manager role offers an uncapped bonus potential. Individual starting salary within this range may depend on geography, experience, expertise, and education/training.
  
We are committed to caring for our people, which is why our retention has been over 90% for the last five years. It’s why we haven’t gone through any waves of layoffs – even during the COVID-19 pandemic. We value development, which is why 80-90% of our roles are filled internally. It’s why most of our account managers come from a non-construction background.
  
  
Success at Hilti comes down to teamwork and ability – the Hilti culture is contagious, and we have an excellent mix of people who are always looking to help one another.
  
This job is #LI-Hybrid, meaning it is field-based and requires daily customer in-person interaction with your home serving as your office location.

**Why Hilti**
-------------

Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation, with more than 34,000 team members across 120 countries. Guided by our purpose, Making Construction Better, we’re driven to keep learning, growing, and finding new ways to make a lasting impact. Here, you’ll be empowered to use your strengths, work with a global and inclusive team, and take on meaningful challenges. At Hilti, you’ll have the chance to make your ideas, achievements, and growth real through purpose, passion, and teamwork.

**Company Overview**  
Hybron is an advanced manufacturing company that is building lightweight composites at mass production scale. At Hybron, we have pioneered a new composites manufacturing process that enables complex, high-performance composite parts to be produced 10-100 times faster than traditional manufacturing, at a fraction of the cost.  
  
We recently closed an oversubscribed $25M seed round, are backed by the Northrop Grumman Technology Accelerator, and are rapidly growing to commercialize and mass produce composite products at a scale never seen before. Our current focus is applying our proprietary process to composite artillery shells, solid rocket motor nozzles, gas turbine engine components, and airframes.  
  
If you want to join a rapidly growing company working on cutting edge composites technology while building capabilities for the warfighter and reshoring U.S. manufacturing, then we want to speak with you.  
  
**About the Role**  
This is a full-time, in-person role at our Hawthorne facility. As you will be working at an early-stage deep tech startup, this role will span many different tasks. Along with these high expectations comes the opportunity to significantly influence the development, strategy, and trajectory of a fast-growing startup company. Your work will tangibly impact our company and the composites industry, and you will be able to make rapid professional gains in an environment that encourages growth and innovation.  
  
This is a hands-on role. About half of your time will go to running the office and facility: vendors, supplies, visitors, shipping & receiving, and the systems that keep a growing, security-conscious team productive and compliant. The other half goes to supporting our leadership team: calendars, travel, reservations, expense reports, meetings, notes, filings and the details that let them stay focused on customers, investors, and the team. You’ll report to our CEO and work closely with our leadership team. You’ll also support the company as a whole with company-sponsored events and swag, as well as people functions such as onboarding and offboarding.  
  
This role requires a high-trust, self-starting generalist. You are a great fit if you can operate with autonomy in high-energy, fast-growing companies, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are great at juggling several responsibilities. You excel in prioritizing the important things, and are able to protect focus time on executives’ calendars. If you are highly organized, discreet, and calm under pressure, who take ownership and enjoy building systems in a fast-moving startup, we want you.  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* U.S. Person status pursuant to the EAR and ITAR definitions.
* 3+ years of experience in office management, executive assistance, or administrative operations, ideally at a startup or in another fast-paced environment.
* Available to work full-time, Monday–Friday, in person at our Hawthorne facility.
* Exceptional proactive organization and follow-through: you keep many details moving at once and close every loop.
* Excellent prioritization skills, knowing what is urgent and what is important.
* Sound judgment and discretion with confidential, sensitive, and export-controlled information, knowing when to take action and when to ask for clarity.
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with employees, executives, vendors, and visitors.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, and quick to learn new software.
* Calm, service-minded, and resourceful under pressure.

  
**Nice to Haves**

* Experience in a defense, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment, including familiarity with ITAR, CMMC, or visitor control.
* Experience managing facility, IT, or security vendors and service contracts.
* Accounts payable, bookkeeping, or spend-management tool experience.
* Event planning experience.

  
**Growth Opportunity and Targets**  
As you grow with Hybron, your responsibilities are expected to shift and evolve:

* Build out our workplace as we scale: lead facility expansions and new sites, and own the facilities budget and vendor contracts.
* Hire and lead a small office and facilities team (front desk, facilities, and admin support) as headcount grows.
* Extend your support to new executives as the leadership team grows.

Pomelo is a boutique NYC-based staffing company. We began as an offshore recruiting firm and have recently evolved into an executive search firm that places top-tier US-based business generalists (former consultants and investment bankers) in operating roles at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. We work with some of the fastest-growing tech companies and iconic consumer brands, from New York to San Francisco.  
  
**ABOUT THE ROLE**  
We are building a pool of exceptional Executive Assistant / Executive Business Partner candidates for opportunities at leading startups and high-growth companies across the US. EAs work closely with founders, CEOs, and executive teams to drive high-priority initiatives, solve complex business problems, and help the company operate more effectively. This is a highly cross-functional role that can span strategy, operations, special projects, business development, finance, and organizational planning. We are specifically looking for candidates with a strong business generalist background, particularly former management consultants or investment bankers who have demonstrated exceptional analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. As opportunities arise, selected candidates will be considered for EA roles that match their experience, interests, and career goals.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the right hand to the executives for all administrative and operational tasks, helping the executives save time and resources
* Manage/organize email inboxes and calendars for the executives, including prioritizing calls/meetings based on business needs and scheduling travel/itineraries as requested
* Proactively follow-up with timely reminders and to-do lists
* Set the agenda and discussion points/topics for the executives' meetings
* Act as the main point of contact for various projects, including corresponding with third-parties, coordinating and prioritizing meetings, and organizing events from start to finish

* Actively listen to executives' feedback and gather insights to constantly identify opportunities for business improvement
* Handle basic financial tasks such as expense tracking, invoicing, budgeting, and reimbursement
* Ensure that all deadlines are met and all work is produced in a timely manner
* Perform ad hoc administrative, business operations, and special project tasks as needed
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to senior leadership and help ensure key priorities continue moving forward

  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **2-4 years of experience at a top-tier management consulting firm or investment bank required**
* Exceptional candidates may have additional experience at a high-growth startup, technology company, or other operating environment
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems with limited direction
* Excellent analytical, financial modeling, and quantitative skills
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
* Strong executive presence and ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders.
* Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously
* Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
* Bachelor's degree from a strong academic institution
* Willingness to work in NYC, San Francisco, Los Angeles, or other major startup hubs depending on the specific opportunity

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

Compensation will vary by company, seniority, and location. Typical EA opportunities in our network offer competitive base salary and bonuses.

Pomelo works directly with candidates throughout the search process to identify opportunities that align with their background, career goals, and interests.

This entry-level account manager role develops relationships as a trusted advisor with a portfolio of clients, connecting with key business executives and stakeholders. The role configures, prices and quotes power and thermal solutions for the customer while also bringing in other team members to find cross-selling opportunities. After securing the order this role manages the order to meet all customer requirements to maximize profitability to the office and company. As new company initiatives are created, this role is responsible in supporting and driving those initiatives in their territory.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Maintains a Sales Plan for each assigned account and works with management to find new clients and opportunities.
* Sells Vertiv power/thermal products and services to client representatives, such as engineers, architects, or other professional and technical personnel at commercial, industrial, and other establishments.
* Collaborates with other Account Managers in the territory to offer the best possible customer experience to Vertiv customers.
* Maintains a pipeline in CRM with 3x quota level of personal sales activity.
* Develops relationships within our customer organizations.
* Prepares and follows up on quotations.
* Provides general sales support to customers.
* Builds rapport with customers through regular in-field customer visits.
* Prepares customer submittals, from order entry to shipment with a focus on thermal solutions.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Minimum Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering or business-related degree (or equivalent combination of education and experience).

* Ability to learn technical data and translate it to others.
* Proficient in executing tactical plans to win business.
* Coachable and willing to learn.
* Strong interpersonal skills a must – brings customer first mindset to internal and external interactions.
* Self-disciplined with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong organizational skills, detail oriented, and excellent problem-solving abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

**Preferred Job Qualifications:**

* Power and/or Thermal technical sales experience.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk working on a computer.
* Frequent driving.

**ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS**

* Standard office environment.
* Road conditions while driving.

**TRAVEL TIME REQUIRED**

* 50%

*The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.*

***OUR CORE PRINCIPLES:*** *Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.*

***OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES***

* *High-Performance Culture*
* *Customer Focus*
* *Operational Excellence*
* *Innovation*
* *Financial Strength*

***OUR BEHAVIORS***

* *Own It*

* *Foster a Customer-First Mindset*
* *Think Big and Execute*
* *Lead by Example*
* *Drive Continuous Improvement*

Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally, and grow with their business needs. As an Account Manager, you will engage with clients across diverse industries, utilizing innovative solutions to solve complex challenges. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to sell a diverse portfolio of services and products from leading technology vendors, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) and enterprise solutions providers.

* Collaborate with the team to identify and pursue new business opportunities with Mid-Tier and Fortune 1000 companies

jobs.description:
**Customer Success Specialist – SaaS Software**

**Company:** Suntek Systems Inc.

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, W-2

**Pay:** Starting at $28.00 per hour, negotiable based on qualifications and experience

**Benefits:** Health Insurance, Dental Insurance

**About Suntek Systems**

Suntek Systems Inc. is an established software company specializing in technology solutions for the international freight forwarding and logistics industry.

We develop and provide software solutions that help logistics companies simplify complex operations, improve productivity, and manage their businesses more efficiently.

Our solutions include cloud-based freight management software, business automation, electronic data integration, and AI-powered technologies.

As we continue to expand our SaaS and AI automation solutions, we are looking for motivated individuals who want to build their careers in business software and technology.

We are a hands-on, customer-focused team that values problem-solving, continuous learning, individual responsibility, and long-term customer relationships.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a motivated, detail-oriented **Customer Success Specialist** to join our team.

This is more than a traditional customer service position. You will work directly with business customers to help them understand and effectively use our software, resolve operational challenges, and improve their overall experience.

You will also collaborate with our internal teams to support customer onboarding, software training, issue resolution, and the introduction of new technologies.

This position offers an opportunity to develop practical experience in SaaS technology, business operations, customer relationship management, and AI-driven automation.

We are looking for someone who enjoys learning, solving problems, communicating with customers, and taking responsibility for delivering results.

Key Responsibilities

* Provide software assistance and ongoing support to business customers.
* Conduct customer onboarding and software training.
* Understand customer workflows and recommend practical software solutions.
* Investigate customer issues and coordinate with internal technical and development teams.
* Maintain strong customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Help customers improve productivity through effective software utilization.
* Support the introduction and adoption of new SaaS and AI automation solutions.
* Document customer inquiries, track open issues, and ensure timely follow-up.
* Communicate customer feedback and improvement suggestions to internal teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* **Bachelor's degree.**
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Comfortable using computers and learning new software applications.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through on responsibilities.
* Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a team.

**Preferred, but Not Required**

* Experience in customer success, customer support, or account management.
* Familiarity with SaaS applications or business software.
* **Additional language skills in Korean or Chinese are a plus**, but not required.

What We Offer

* Opportunities to develop professional skills in SaaS and business technology.
* Hands-on experience with cloud software and emerging AI technologies.
* Direct involvement in solving real-world business challenges.
* A collaborative environment with close interaction across teams.
* Opportunities to take on broader responsibilities as the company grows.
* A practical, supportive, and customer-focused workplace.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You will be a great fit if you are curious about technology, enjoy helping people, and take pride in solving problems.

We value individuals who are dependable, proactive, organized, and eager to continuously develop their skills.

**Join Suntek Systems and build your career in business software, SaaS technology, and AI-driven automation.**

*Suntek Systems Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.*

* Health insurance

Education:

Language:

* Chinese (Preferred)
* Korean (Preferred)

jobs.title: TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

  

Position Type: Temporary, Full-Time (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt  
Employment Period: January–June 2027  
Reports To: Schools Program Manager  
Location: In-person at SFUSD school sites and LYRIC’s Purple House, San Francisco  
Hourly Rate: $30.58/hour (non-negotiable per LYRIC’s equity-based pay model)  
Union Status: Union position (OPEIU Local 29)

ABOUT THE POSITION

LYRIC seeks a thoughtful and experienced Temporary Schools Program Coordinator to deliver school-based support groups for SFUSD students, creating affirming spaces for LGBTQQ+ youth to strengthen positive identity development, self-esteem, personal growth, and peer connection. Serving 120 youth annually, the program offers weekly groups exploring healthy relationships, self-confidence, identity, and navigating school and community systems. Each cohort includes 3–10 students, averaging 5 participants, with sessions lasting up to 60 minutes, typically held in high school Wellness Centers or school-based health centers. The coordinator also connects students with LYRIC’s Purple House programs and supports programming there during spring break and summer break dates within the January–June employment period.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Youth Development & Engagement: Build on young people’s strengths, center their voices and choices, and support their leadership, independence, and progress toward their goals.

* Equity & Inclusion: Create affirming environments for LGBTQQ+ youth across identities and backgrounds. Practice cultural humility, examine personal biases, and recognize how systemic barriers affect young people’s lives.

* Relationship Building & Collaboration: Build trust with youth, coworkers, and community partners. Coordinate services, share relevant information appropriately, and contribute to shared goals.

* Effective Communication: Listen actively, communicate clearly and respectfully, and address concerns directly and constructively. Adapt communication to different needs and situations.

* Emotional Awareness & Self-Management: Recognize how personal emotions and reactions affect others. Remain grounded during challenging interactions and respond with empathy, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach.

* Critical Thinking & Sound Judgment: Assess situations, identify appropriate next steps, and recognize when to seek guidance. Respond to safety concerns within established protocols and the scope of the role.

* Professional Integrity & Accountability: Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for actions. Communicate barriers early and follow organizational policies.

* Program Delivery & Organization: Prepare and deliver purposeful services and activities, manage time and resources responsibly, and complete accurate, timely documentation and follow-up.

* Learning & Adaptability: Seek and apply feedback, build relevant skills, and adjust to changing youth and program needs. Use reflection and experience to improve practice.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Youth Development & Group Facilitation

* Facilitate weekly support groups promoting positive identity development, self-esteem, healthy relationships, personal growth, and peer connection.
* Center youth voices and choices, creating opportunities for leadership and meaningful participation.
* Prepare and adapt age-appropriate curriculum informed by positive youth development, harm reduction, and youth sexual health education.
* Create inclusive, affirming environments that reflect students’ identities and address barriers to participation.
* Provide individual check-ins and basic resource support while maintaining boundaries and supporting youth independence.
* Respond to challenging group dynamics with empathy, self-awareness, and appropriate de-escalation; seek support when needed.

School-to-Community Connections

* Connect students with programs, services, and opportunities at LYRIC’s Purple House.
* Coordinate introductions, referrals, and follow-up with colleagues to help students access services and maintain engagement.
* Support Purple House programming during spring break and summer break dates within the employment period.

Program Planning & Partnerships

* Plan weekly sessions of up to 45 minutes for cohorts of 3–10 students.
* Prepare materials in advance, manage responsibilities across school sites, and use time and resources responsibly.
* Build collaborative relationships with school staff, counselors, Wellness Center staff, and community partners.
* Coordinate schedules, meeting spaces, and student referrals; communicate expectations and changes clearly.
* Participate in student support meetings when appropriate, sharing information within confidentiality requirements and the scope of the role.
* Use student feedback and participation data to improve programming and contribute to the program’s annual goal of serving 120 youth.

Documentation, Accountability & Safety

* Maintain accurate, timely records of participation, activities, referrals, and outcomes in LYRIC’s data systems.
* Contribute to program reports and funder documentation.
* Protect confidential information and follow procedures for storing and sharing records.
* Recognize safety concerns, follow reporting and response protocols, and consult the Schools Program Manager when guidance is needed.
* Follow through on commitments and communicate barriers early.

Teamwork & Professional Growth

* Participate in supervision, team meetings, trainings, and organization-wide events.
* Collaborate across departments and contribute to shared responsibilities.
* Seek and apply feedback, reflect on personal assumptions and reactions, and take responsibility for improvement.
* Adapt to changing school and program needs while communicating about priorities and capacity.
* Support an organized transition of program information and outstanding follow-up at the end of the assignment.

YOU BRING

jobs.title: YB PRO Social Media Account Coordinator

**YB PRO Social Media Account Coordinator**

**About the Role**  
The YB PRO Social Media Account Coordinator manages the day-to-day execution of assigned YouthBeat PRO client  
relationships. The role sits between high-level account strategy and the production work needed to deliver on each client’s communications scope. The Coordinator keeps client communication responsive, translates priorities into production briefs and assignments, tracks approvals and deliverables, and makes sure monthly commitments are completed and documented. The Account Coordinator is not expected to independently set pricing, contract scope, major creative direction, crisis response, or organization-level strategy. The role creates enough structure and client follow-through for the Director / Communications Lead to focus on growth, relationships, strategy, creative direction, and higher-stakes decisions.

**Core Responsibilities**  
**Client Onboarding & Account Setup**

* Set up new accounts using YouthBeat’s standard client onboarding process, including account brief, goals, audiences, platforms, content pillars, cadence, approval path, access, shared folders, meeting rhythm, and scope tracker.
* Confirm who can approve content, which assets are available, what media-release or privacy rules apply, and which client contacts own program information before production begins.
* Document client preferences and recurring needs so knowledge does not live only in meetings or one person’s inbox.

**Weekly Account Management & Client Communication**

* Prepare for and participate in recurring client meetings with a current view of upcoming content, open approvals, needed assets, recent performance, and next steps.
* Send or document clear follow-ups after meetings, including decisions, owners, deadlines, requested assets, and unresolved questions.
* Maintain routine professional communication with client contacts and follow up before missing information threatens a deliverable.
* Flag relationship concerns, repeated approval delays, major changes in direction, or requests that may affect scope to the Director / Communications Lead.

**Content Planning & Production Coordination**

* Maintain each assigned account’s content calendar and translate approved priorities into specific posts, Stories, Reels, graphics, photo/video assignments, field coverage, and community-management tasks.
* Create production briefs that identify objective, audience, platform, deliverable, assets, context, deadline, approval path, and client-specific standards.
* Coordinate assignments across apprentices and production contributors; make sure work is distributed realistically against deadlines and available hours.
* Complete first-pass review for accuracy, brand alignment, accessibility basics, release status, spelling, links, tags, and completeness before final approval.
* Consolidate revisions and keep the next action and deadline visible.

**Apprentice Management & Learning**

* Assign meaningful client work to YB PRO apprentices with clear briefs, examples, due dates, and review expectations.

* Confirm apprentices understand the client, audience, brand voice, file structure, and professional expectations before independent assignments.
* Provide routine coaching and first-line feedback and coordinate revisions before work advances.
* Work with the Communications Coordinator and Director / Communications Lead to identify portfolio-ready projects, training needs, and readiness for more responsibility.

**Deliverables, Scope & Reporting**  

* Track contracted deliverables, production units, posting commitments, community-management time, meetings, and other recurring responsibilities throughout the month.
* Maintain organized client folders with briefs, assets, working files, approvals, final exports, published links, reports, and meeting documentation.
* Identify out-of-scope requests before YouthBeat commits additional time or deliverables and escalate scope or pricing questions.
* Prepare monthly account reports summarizing completed work, performance highlights, key wins, challenges, outstanding items, and next priorities.
* Use performance and client feedback to recommend practical workflow or content adjustments for leadership review.
* Ensure client media is properly managed and archived by apprentices and junior producers, according to our policies.

**Role Authority & Escalation**

The Account Coordinator may manage routine client communication, production coordination, calendars, assignments, first-pass review, approval tracking, approved publishing, and account reporting. The role may not independently change contract scope, pricing, major strategy, public positions, crisis response, sensitive youth or personnel communications, or commitments that create new YouthBeat obligations.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong client-service and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, approvals, requests, and contributors.
* Professional written and verbal communication, including comfort leading routine client check-ins.
* Experience in communications, social media, marketing, content production, account coordination, community engagement, or related work.
* Working knowledge of content calendars, social publishing, basic analytics, and photo/video/graphic production workflows.
* Ability to coach young people professionally while still protecting client quality standards and deadlines.
* Strong judgment around confidentiality, consent, youth safety, scope boundaries, and escalation.
