jobs.title: Events & Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Zilliz is a fast-growing startup developing the industry’s leading vector database for enterprise-grade AI. Founded by the engineers behind Milvus, the world’s most popular open-source vector database, the company builds next-generation database technologies to help organizations quickly create AI applications. On a mission to democratize AI, Zilliz is committed to simplifying data management for AI applications and making vector databases accessible to every organization.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an Events & Operations Specialist to help plan and execute Zilliz's marketing and community events, while also supporting selected internal operations.

You'll work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Developer Relations teams to coordinate everything from developer meetups and customer events to industry conferences and trade shows. This is a hands-on role that involves working with both internal teams and external partners to keep projects organized and events running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who's organized, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative. You should enjoy working with different people, solving problems as they come up, and finding ways to improve how things get done. Events will be your primary focus, with a smaller portion of the role dedicated to internal operational and administrative support.

### **What You'll Do**

**Events & Marketing Support**

* Coordinate the planning and execution of developer meetups, community gatherings, sales events, conferences, and trade shows, primarily across North America and Europe.
* Manage event logistics, including registration, attendee communications, venue arrangements, vendors, materials, and on-site coordination.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, and DevRel teams to understand event objectives, coordinate resources, and ensure activities are delivered on schedule.
* Maintain event timelines, budgets, and task lists, follow up with stakeholders, and address issues that could affect execution.
* Coordinate with external vendors, venues, speakers, and partners throughout the event planning process.
* Contribute ideas to improve event formats, attendee engagement, and the overall event experience.
* Support post-event activities, including attendee follow-ups, lead coordination, feedback collection, and basic performance reporting.

**Internal Operations & Administrative Support**

* Assist with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate internal meetings, team activities, and other operational needs as they arise.
* Support improvements to internal processes and team coordination where needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in event marketing, event coordination, operations, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience organizing events or managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments.
* A proactive approach to work, with the ability to identify problems, take initiative, and move projects forward with limited supervision.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience coordinating across internal teams and working with external vendors or partners.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where priorities can change and processes may not always be clearly defined.
* A practical, resourceful approach to problem-solving, along with the willingness to contribute new ideas and take on different types of work.
* Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally to support events.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with developer meetups, technical community events, or B2B technology conferences.
* Familiarity with developer communities, open-source technologies, AI, or data infrastructure.
* Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.
* Familiarity with event management, project management, or marketing tools.

jobs.title: Community Manager (San Francisco)
jobs.description:
Hey! We’re team Granola We’re building the leading AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings, a product that’s spreading through teams and redefining how knowledge is captured and used. We help teams turn messy call notes into structured insight, so they can spend more time focusing on what’s important and less time on admin.

**Why we care about community**
-------------------------------

When people find Granola, they tend to really love it. Community is how we bring that feeling offline, into a room with other people who feel the same.

We’ve run 100+ events with more than 5,000 people, starting in London, and learnt a lot about what makes people come back.

In SF, we’ve opened an office and run a number of events, experimenting as we go: our GTM Series, a demo night with Linear, a GTM hackathon with Anthropic and more. Now we’re looking for someone to take it beyond the experimental phase and build a well-oiled machine, known as one of the best places in SF for tech community and events.

We don’t measure community in signups. It’s brand marketing, and it’s how we show people what Granola is like in person.

### **Our goal**

Make Granola one of the best AI-native, human brands for professionals.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

You’ll own generating event ideas and community initiatives and the execution those ideas:

* Come up with event and community ideas, and think hard about what makes an event special
* Curate the guest list so a great group of people show up
* Own all comms with speakers, partners and guests
* Run logistics like a station master, so everything leaves on time
* Own the marketing for every event, from the copy to the socials, so the room is full
* Work closely with our brand and events teams in London, who hold the bar on how Granola shows up
* Pitch in on big product launches when we need all hands
* Build relationships with the top accelerators and VCs in the Bay (e.g. YC, Neo, HF0, SPC). Be there when new cohorts land, so Granola is the first tool founders reach for on day one

**How you’ll know it’s working**
--------------------------------

* Within 6 months, people in SF say Granola puts on some of the best tech events in the city
* Before that:

  + Your events fill up are oversubscribed with the relevant folks for each event
  + Great event and community ideas keep coming
  + You own and run logistics like clockwork

**About you**
-------------

**Your background**

* 5+ years in community and events, venture, startup ecosystems or partnerships
* A track record of running great events for a tech audience consistently
* Comfortable talking to execs and founders

**Bonus points**

* A strong network in Bay Area tech, with relationships across founders, accelerators or VCs

**As a person, you**

* **Work autonomously.** You set direction together with Shre and the team, then run with it. Take feedback well - you get curious, adjust quickly, and show the change in your next piece of work
* **Sweat the details.** For every event, you think about the one thing that will make people remember it and feel special. You treat the attendee experience like a user flow: from the moment someone arrives outside our office, to checking in, to knowing where the bathroom is before they have to ask
* **Get startups and tech.** You’re always reading, listening and learning about the fastest-growing startups, founders and operators, and you know what founders care about
* **Have great judgment.** You come up with original ideas and have the instincts to know what’s right for Granola’s brand. Our bar is high, and you’re always open to learning how to meet it
* **Roll up your sleeves.** This is a founding community role. You’re as comfortable emailing a unicorn founder as you are Ubering to a restaurant yourself to pick up pizza boxes if DoorDash is horrendously late to make sure everyone’s fed. No task is beneath you
* **Love being around people.** You get energy from meeting people, can work a crowd, and can say no politely but firmly
* **Embody the core Granola traits:** hardworking, kind and incredibly ambitious

**Compensation**
----------------

Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, plus equity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart’s demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

SGS is the global leader and innovator in inspection, verification, testing and certification services. Founded in 1878, SGS is recognized as the global benchmark in quality and integrity. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technically credible account manager who can build long-term customer relationships while also actively creating new business opportunities.

This person does not need to be a hands-on test engineer, but should be comfortable discussing technologies such as PCIe, USB, and Ethernet etc with engineering customers, understanding their challenges, and connecting those needs with the appropriate testing or engineering services.

Experience in the test & measurement or independent testing laboratory industry would be a significant advantage, particularly for candidates who already understand the Silicon Valley semiconductor and electronics ecosystem.

* Demonstrated ability to identify and develop new business opportunities within both existing and prospective accounts. The role is expected to include approximately 30% business development / new opportunity creation in addition to account management responsibilities.
* Working knowledge of high-speed digital interfaces such as:
  + PCI Express (PCIe)
  + USB / USB4
  + HDMI
  + Displayport
  + Ethernet, and so on

The candidate is not expected to be a test engineer, but must have sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with engineering customers, understand their product development and testing needs, and identify relevant business opportunities.

* Self-motivated and comfortable working in a role that combines account ownership with proactive business development.
* Ability and willingness to travel to customer sites within the Bay Area and occasionally outside the region as required.

Highly Preferred

* Previous sales or account management experience with a test laboratory, test & measurement equipment manufacturer, semiconductor company, or related engineering services organization.
* Existing relationships or experience working with semiconductor, computing, data center, networking, automotive, or consumer electronics companies in Silicon Valley.
* Familiarity with industry compliance and certification ecosystems such as PCI-SIG, USB-IF, Ethernet/IEEE, or other high-speed interface standards organizations.
* Experience selling technical services or solutions involving electrical compliance testing, protocol testing, interoperability testing, validation, or high-speed signal integrity.
* Demonstrated track record of growing existing accounts while developing new customers or new business within existing customers.

***Compensation***

The expected salary for this position is $120,000 to $140,000 per year This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary we reasonably expect to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on skills, experience, and qualifications.

You'll work closely with DCL's sales and marketing leadership to identify high-value prospects, develop outbound strategies and create qualified opportunities for the sales team.

The ideal candidate is competitive, curious and comfortable speaking with executives and operations leaders at growing consumer brands.

**Location Requirements:** This is a hybrid position. Candidates must currently reside within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the following locations: Louisville, KY; York, PA; the San Francisco Bay Area, CA; Ontario, CA; or the greater Southern California area.

**What You'll Do**

* Prospect and develop new business opportunities across ecommerce, retail and omnichannel brands
* Identify companies experiencing growth, fulfillment challenges, retail expansion or potential 3PL transition events
* Engage CEOs, founders, COOs, Heads of Operations, Supply Chain and Logistics leaders
* Qualify opportunities based on order volume, revenue, fulfillment requirements, technology, retail channels and growth plans
* Schedule qualified discovery meetings for DCL's sales team
* Research target accounts and develop personalized outreach strategies
* Maintain accurate prospecting activity, contacts and opportunities in HubSpot
* Partner with Marketing on campaigns, industry events and target-account strategies
* Consistently achieve weekly and monthly activity, meeting and pipeline goals

**What We're Looking For**

* **2+ years of SDR, BDR or business development experience**
* Experience within **3PL, ecommerce fulfillment, warehousing, logistics or supply chain** strongly preferred
* Proven success generating qualified meetings through outbound prospecting
* Comfortable engaging senior decision-makers
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Experience with CRM and sales prospecting platforms; HubSpot and LinkedIn Sales Navigator experience is a plus
* Understanding of Shopify, Amazon, retail fulfillment or ecommerce operations is a plus
* Self-motivated and comfortable working in a performance-driven sales environment
* Located in **Southern California or the San Francisco Bay Area**

**Who Will Be Especially Successful Here**

You've sold logistics or fulfillment before and understand the conversation.

You know what questions to ask when a brand is growing faster than its current operation can support. You recognize signals such as service problems, rising shipping costs, retail expansion, new funding, rapid ecommerce growth or dissatisfaction with an incumbent 3PL.

Most importantly, you enjoy prospecting and turning those signals into conversations.

We're looking for someone who wants to build a career in logistics sales—not remain an SDR forever.

Successful performance in this position can create a path toward an **Account Executive / Sales role**, with the opportunity to own and close larger 3PL opportunities.

**Who You Are:**

The Community Coordinator will bring a passion for Harlem Children’s Zone's mission: breaking the cycle of intergenerational poverty with comprehensive, on-the-ground programming that builds opportunities for children and families to thrive in school, work, and life.

The Community Coordinator plays a vital role in fostering engagement, strengthening program implementation, and enhancing community partnerships within HCZ’s multi-generational community center. Serving youth, adults, and seniors, this role builds trusted relationships with participants and families, supports high-quality program delivery, and ensures that community voices are heard and reflected in the center’s activities. The Coordinator collaborates closely with program and leadership staff to promote consistent attendance, develop partnerships, and track outcomes aligned with HCZ’s mission of breaking the cycle of poverty.

* Build meaningful connections with youth, adults, and senior participants.
* Serve as a primary liaison between the community center and families.
* Conduct outreach and maintain regular communication through phone calls, in-person meetings, and events.

### **2. Attendance and Retention Support**

* Track daily and weekly attendance across all program areas.
* Identify and address barriers to consistent participation.
* Implement strategies that improve retention and deepen participant investment.

### **3. Community and Partner Engagement**

* Develop and sustain partnerships with local organizations, service providers, and community leaders.

### **4. Program Development and Implementation**

* Lead daily operations and logistics of youth, adult, and senior programs.
* Collaborate with site staff to ensure high-quality, engaging, and culturally relevant programming.
* Offer input on program design and lead portions of programming when needed.
* Coordinate program logistics and maintain organized tracking of deliverables and timelines.

### **5. Data Tracking and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of attendance, engagement, and referral outcomes using designated systems.
* Prepare monthly reports and present findings to leadership.
* Use data to drive continuous program improvement.

**July** – **August:**

* Monday – Friday (10:30am- 6:30pm) and select Saturdays

* Associate's or Bachelor’s degree in Human Services, Education, Social Work, or a related field.

* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across generations and cultures.
* Experience with program coordination, community outreach, or case management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or database systems for tracking and reporting.

  
**Benefits**

As a member of the Harlem Children's Zone team, you will join a supportive and inclusive community dedicated to helping children, families — and our staff — thrive. We offer highly competitive salaries, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for growth.

**Our exceptional full-time benefits include:**

* Highly competitive base salaries
* Merit-based performance increase
* Paid time off
* Employee referral bonus
* Career advancement

* Life Insurance
* Short-and long-term disability
* Additional voluntary benefits
* Wellness discounts
* Commuter benefits
* Financial wellness perks
* Additional benefits (discounts on flights, hotels, theme parks, concert tickets, and more)

The salary range for this position is $50,000 - $60,000 per year.

jobs.title: US Account Manager E-Commerce
jobs.description:
Hello. We’re Polaroid. An iconic brand, built by passionate people

Polaroid was founded in 1937 by one of the 20th century’s most influential innovators, Edwin Land, whose philosophy was: *“Don’t undertake a project unless it is manifestly important and nearly impossible.”*  
  
In 2008, Polaroid produced its last pack of instant film. But a group of passionate fans refused to let instant photography disappear. What started as The Impossible Project grew into a mission to preserve and reinvent analogue photography for a new generation. More than a decade later, that same startup acquired the Polaroid brand and continues to shape its future today.

At Polaroid, we create products and experiences that spark emotion, fuel creativity, and bring people closer together. At the intersection of art and technology, we believe in the power of analogue moments and genuine human connection in an increasingly digital world.

**The Role**

As the Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in managing and expanding Polaroid's footprint across independent retailers, distributors, resellers, and e-commerce marketplaces. We are looking for an experienced account manager with strong business acumen, execution skills, and a deep understanding of retail and online sales channels to deliver profitable customer growth and increase market share.

This role will be responsible for managing key reseller and distributor relationships, supporting marketplace growth initiatives, monitoring channel compliance, and protecting the integrity of the Polaroid brand across retail and e-commerce platforms. The ideal candidate will have experience with Amazon and other online marketplaces, retail channel management, MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance, listing optimization, and the Photo Specialty retail channel.

In addition to channel and operational management responsibilities, this role will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across sales operations, finance, demand planning, product management, and marketing.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Focus on growing and developing existing customers while identifying and securing new business opportunities across retail, reseller, distributor, and marketplace channels.
* Manage the total account relationship, including new business acquisition, customer retention, expansion opportunities, and strategic account planning.
* Develop and maintain strong partnerships with distributors, resellers, and specialty photo retailers to achieve sales and profitability goals.
* Achieve revenue, profit, and market share targets for assigned accounts and strategic channel partners.
* Lead new market penetration initiatives and optimize existing channel performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally to plan and execute product launches, promotions, events, and marketing initiatives that drive sell-through and maximize ROI.
* Conduct product and assortment planning with retail and online partners to drive mutually beneficial business results.
* Create and maintain sales forecasts and demand plans to support business planning and inventory management.
* Analyze sales, inventory, and market trends to recommend pricing, assortment, and promotional strategies.
* Monitor sell-through performance and implement corrective actions as necessary.
* Set up, maintain, and optimize product content, imagery, and merchandising assets across retailer and marketplace portals.
* Monitor listing health, content compliance, product availability, and brand representation across Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Ensure all marketplace listings comply with Polaroid brand guidelines, content standards, and retailer requirements.
* Monitor and enforce MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance across reseller, distributor, and online marketplace channels.
* Protect and monitor retail and e-commerce channels to identify unauthorized sellers, pricing violations, diversion, and brand integrity concerns.
* Manage and support marketplace reseller relationships to ensure compliance, profitability, and sustainable growth.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve content, inventory, operational, and fulfillment issues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2-5 years of account management, sales, e-commerce, or channel management experience.
* Familiar working with Amazon and other major online marketplaces.
* Experience managing distributors, resellers, and specialty retail accounts.
* Strong knowledge of MAP compliance, channel management, and brand protection best practices.
* Understanding of marketplace listing health, product content optimization, and digital merchandising.
* Experience in consumer electronics, photography, imaging, or Photo Specialty retail channels preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, forecasting, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and account management tools.

**AI in our hiring process**

Our recruitment team reviews every application, including your CV. We may use AI-assisted technology to support the initial review process and help our recruiters work more efficiently. Your application is always reviewed by a recruiter and all our hiring decisions are made by people. Learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.polaroid.com/legal/careers-job-applicant-privacy-policy

**Our Approach to AI**

At Polaroid we believe two things can be true at once: technology can help us move forward, while human creativity, craft, judgement and real-world connection matter more than ever.

Since our beginning, we've embraced technology to create meaningful human experiences. Today that means exploring new tools, including AI, with curiosity and care, using them where they help us work better and build a stronger business, while staying true to what defines our brand.

Compensation Range: $95K - $120K

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Strategist
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

Fabuwood is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to own and execute the company's digital marketing programs across CRM and email, paid media and other digital channels.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy, execution, coordination, and analysis. The Digital Marketing Specialist will manage day-to-day CRM and email activity, oversee paid advertising, coordinate with internal teams and external partners, and continuously improve performance across the digital customer journey.

The role reports to the Digital Marketing Manager and owns the respective digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard. Success requires strong follow-through, reliable reporting, and the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations and next steps.

***Schedule: M-Th 8:00AM-5:00PM. F 8:00AM-12:00PM***

**Key Responsibilities**

CRM & Email Marketing

* Own the day-to-day management and execution of Fabuwood's CRM and email marketing program in HubSpot.
* Plan, build, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns, including newsletters, product communications, promotions, event follow-up, onboarding, nurture, and re-engagement programs.
* Manage audience segmentation, lists, workflows, automation, personalization, lead routing, and lifecycle stages to ensure communications are relevant and timely.
* Monitor deliverability, engagement, conversions, list health, and campaign performance; use testing and analysis to continuously improve results.

Paid Media

* Lead the day-to-day management and oversight of paid digital media, whether executed internally or through agency and vendor partners.
* Support campaign strategy, audience targeting, budgets, creative requirements, landing pages, tracking, optimization, and reporting across channels such as Google, Meta, YouTube, display, and other relevant platforms.
* Review performance regularly and make recommendations to improve efficiency, lead quality, conversion, and return on marketing investment.

Metrics, Scorecard & Optimization

* Own the digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard, including the accuracy, timeliness, definitions, targets, and reporting cadence for each assigned metric.
* Maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering accountable activity.
* Analyze performance by audience, campaign, channel, and funnel stage to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities.
* Translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans for the Digital Marketing Manager and broader marketing team.
* Work with internal stakeholders and partners to improve tracking, attribution, data quality, and reporting consistency.

Planning & Cross-Functional Execution

* Develop digital channel plans that support product launches, dealer initiatives, A+D programs, events, brand campaigns, and lead-generation goals.
* Manage digital marketing timelines, priorities, budgets, vendors, and deliverables, escalating risks or performance concerns when needed.
* Collaborate closely with creative, content, project management, sales, IT, and other teams to keep campaigns aligned and moving forward.
* Stay current on platform changes, digital best practices, privacy requirements, and emerging opportunities relevant to Fabuwood's audiences.

**Qualifications**

* 3-5 years of hands-on digital marketing experience across CRM/email, paid media, analytics, or related channels.
* Strong working knowledge of HubSpot or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform, including email creation, segmentation, workflows, reporting, and database management.
* Experience managing or overseeing paid media campaigns and interpreting performance across major advertising platforms.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to maintain scorecard metrics, build clear reports, identify meaningful insights, and recommend next steps.
* Understanding of campaign tracking, conversion measurement, attribution, audience segmentation, and funnel performance.
* Excellent project-management, organizational, and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain performance clearly to both marketing and non-marketing stakeholders.
* A proactive, accountable mindset with strong attention to detail and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Looker Studio, and social media management or reporting tools.
* Familiarity with lead nurturing, A/B testing, and marketing attribution.
* Experience working with agencies, media partners, freelancers, or other outside vendors.
* Experience in cabinetry, building products, home improvement, manufacturing, or a dealer-based business model is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means Fabuwood's digital marketing programs are well planned, consistently executed, and clearly measured. CRM and email campaigns are timely and targeted, paid media are actively managed, digital projects move forward, and performance data is accurate and easy to understand.

The Digital Marketing Manager and broader team can rely on the Digital Marketing Specialist to own the details, surface meaningful insights, recommend improvements, and follow through on the actions needed to strengthen digital performance.

Founded in 2017 and headquartered in London, HungryPanda connects people with authentic Chinese and Asian food through its delivery platform. We work with restaurants, grocery businesses, and local teams to help more people discover the food they love.

Our next opportunity in the U.S. is to make HungryPanda known and used by a wider audience. We are looking for a marketing leader who can see the bigger picture, build a plan for growth, and work hands-on with the team to make it happen.

熊猫外卖成立于 2017 年，总部位于伦敦。我们通过外卖平台连接消费者与正宗的中华及亚洲美食，并与餐厅、零售商家及本地团队合作，让更多人发现喜爱的美食。

在美国，我们希望让更广泛的消费者认识并使用 HungryPanda。我们正在寻找一位既有全局视角、又愿意亲自投入执行的市场负责人，带领团队把增长计划变成实际成果。

**About the Role / 岗位介绍**

You will lead digital marketing for the U.S. market, with a clear goal: help more people discover HungryPanda, place their first order, and keep coming back. You will build on our connection with Chinese-speaking communities while finding effective ways to reach a broader U.S. audience.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set priorities and guide the team, while staying close to campaign planning, channel tests, creative work, and performance data. You should be comfortable making strategic decisions and rolling up your sleeves to improve execution.

你将负责美国市场的数字营销工作，目标明确：让更多消费者认识 HungryPanda、完成首次下单，并愿意持续使用。你需要在服务好现有华语用户群体的基础上，探索如何有效触达更广泛的美国消费者。

这是一个需要亲自参与执行的管理岗位。你将确定方向、带领团队，同时深入参与活动策划、渠道测试、内容创意和数据复盘。我们希望你既能做出有依据的策略判断，也能与团队一起把执行做好。

**What You’ll Do / 工作职责**

* **Build a U.S. growth plan.** Identify priority audiences and markets, set clear acquisition and retention goals, and decide where marketing time and budget will have the greatest impact.制定美国市场增长计划。 明确重点用户及城市，设定用户获取与留存目标，并判断团队精力和营销预算应投入在哪里。
* **Bring HungryPanda to a wider audience.** Develop messaging and campaigns that make the platform relevant to Chinese-speaking customers and to other U.S. consumers interested in Asian food. Test what helps new audiences understand, trust, and try the service.让更多消费者接受 HungryPanda。 针对华语用户，以及对亚洲美食感兴趣的更广泛美国消费者，制定合适的传播内容和活动，测试哪些方式能促使新用户了解、信任并尝试平台。
* **Lead channels and campaigns hands-on.** Guide work across Xiaohongshu (RED), Instagram, WeChat communities, TikTok, paid digital channels, and other relevant platforms. Get directly involved in briefs, creative reviews, launches, and improvements when needed.亲自参与渠道及活动执行。 统筹小红书、Instagram、微信社群、TikTok、付费数字渠道及其他合适的平台；根据需要亲自参与需求制定、内容审核、上线及优化。
* **Turn awareness into orders.** Work with Product, Operations, and local teams to understand the customer journey, improve first-order conversion, and create reasons for customers to order again.把品牌认知转化为订单。 与产品、运营及本地团队协作，了解用户从看到广告到完成下单的过程，改善首单转化，并推动复购。
* **Build effective creator and community programs.** Develop KOL/KOC, creator, and community partnerships that fit different audiences and markets; measure their contribution beyond views and engagement alone.建立有效的达人及社群合作。 针对不同用户和城市开展 KOL/KOC、内容创作者及社群合作，并关注其对实际业务增长的贡献。
* **Connect national direction with local execution.** Partner with City Managers and local Marketing teams to adapt campaigns to each market’s customers, merchants, and opportunities.结合全国方向与本地执行。与城市经理及本地市场团队合作，根据各城市的用户、商家和市场机会调整活动。
* **Use data to make decisions.** Track campaign spend and results, including customer acquisition, first orders, repeat orders, and channel performance. Run tests, share what works, and change course when results fall short.用数据指导决策。 跟踪活动投入与效果，包括新用户获取、首单、复购及渠道表现；通过测试总结有效做法，并及时调整效果不佳的方案。
* **Lead and develop the team.** Set clear priorities, coach team members, coordinate external partners, and maintain a high standard of execution across projects.带领并培养团队。 明确工作重点、指导团队成员、协调外部合作方，并确保各项目的执行质

**What You Bring / 任职要求**

* Strong experience in digital or growth marketing for a consumer platform, marketplace, food delivery business, or other consumer brand, including experience leading people or cross-functional work.具备消费平台、交易平台、外卖业务或其他消费品牌的数字营销或增长营销经验，并有带领团队或跨部门项目的经历。
* A track record of growing an audience and connecting marketing activity to measurable outcomes such as customer acquisition, first purchases, or retention.有扩大用户群体的实际成果，并能说明营销工作如何推动新用户获取、首次购买或留存。
* Ability to set a clear strategy and manage budgets, while remaining comfortable working directly on campaigns, creative, channel tests, and performance reviews.能够制定清晰策略、管理预算，同时愿意亲自参与活动、内容、渠道测试和效果复盘。
* A strong understanding of Chinese-speaking communities in the U.S., along with curiosity and sound judgment about how to reach a broader American audience.深入了解美国华语用户群体，同时有能力和判断力探索如何触达更广泛的美国消费者。
* Strong analytical, communication, and team leadership skills. Comfortable working with City Managers and teams across different functions.具备良好的数据分析、沟通和团队管理能力，能够与城市经理及不同职能团队有效合作。
* Fluency in spoken and written Mandarin Chinese and English is required.必须能流利使用普通话和英语进行口头及书面工作沟通。

If you enjoy building a growth strategy and getting close to the work that brings it to life, we’d love to hear from you.

如果你既喜欢制定增长方向，也愿意深入一线推动执行，欢迎加入我们，一起让更多美国消费者认识并选择 HungryPanda！

Pay: $60,000.00 - $95,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Language:

* Mandarin (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* New York, NY 10123 (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Independent Sales Representative – Pharmacy & Healthcare Technology (1099 Commission-Based)

**Company:** AisleRx  
**Location:** New York and Ohio  
**Job Type:** Independent Contractor (1099)  
**Compensation:** Commission-Based | Uncapped Earning Potential

About AisleRx

AisleRx is bringing innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies, helping pharmacy owners expand their service offerings and capitalize on new opportunities in the evolving healthcare marketplace.

We are seeking ambitious, self-motivated Independent Sales Representatives to introduce AisleRx to independent pharmacy owners and decision-makers throughout New York and Ohio.

This is an opportunity to represent an innovative healthcare solution, build relationships with local business owners, and earn commissions by helping pharmacies discover new ways to serve their customers.

The Opportunity

Are you a natural relationship-builder who enjoys connecting with business owners, opening doors, and turning conversations into business opportunities?

As an AisleRx Sales Representative, you will be responsible for identifying independent and regional pharmacies, establishing relationships with pharmacy owners, presenting the AisleRx solution, and developing opportunities for new business.

This is a **1099 independent contractor position paid on commission, with no guaranteed base salary**. It is ideal for a driven sales professional who values independence, flexibility, and the opportunity to grow earnings through results.

You will have the opportunity to leverage your existing professional network, develop new relationships in the pharmacy industry, and help independent pharmacies explore innovative healthcare solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Develop new business:** Identify and engage independent pharmacies that may benefit from AisleRx's telehealth solution.
* **Build owner relationships:** Connect directly with pharmacy owners, pharmacists-in-charge, and other key decision-makers.
* **Present AisleRx:** Clearly communicate the value proposition and explain how the solution may benefit independent pharmacies.
* **Generate sales opportunities:** Prospect, conduct outreach, schedule meetings, deliver presentations, and follow up with prospective customers.
* **Develop a territory:** Build a pipeline of qualified pharmacy prospects within your assigned geographic area.
* **Drive new partnerships:** Work with interested pharmacies to advance opportunities and convert prospects into customers.
* **Represent AisleRx professionally:** Build trust through knowledgeable conversations, consistent follow-through, and a customer-focused approach.

What We're Looking For

We are interested in people who are entrepreneurial, persuasive, professional, and motivated by results.

**Ideal candidates will have:**

* Experience in pharmaceutical sales, healthcare sales, medical device sales, or B2B sales.
* Existing relationships with independent pharmacy owners or other healthcare decision-makers.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* The ability to prospect independently, generate leads, and develop new business.
* A self-starter mindset and the discipline to manage your own schedule and sales pipeline.
* A professional, consultative sales approach focused on understanding customer needs and communicating value.

**Especially attractive candidates include:**

* Former or current pharmaceutical and medical sales representatives.
* Individuals with established relationships in the independent pharmacy market.
* Pharmacy industry professionals with strong business development skills.
* Experienced B2B sales professionals who know how to reach decision-makers and close business.
* Independent sales agents looking to add an innovative healthcare solution to their portfolio.

Experience in pharmacy or healthcare sales is preferred, but proven sales ability and strong industry relationships are also valuable.

Compensation & Earning Potential

This is a commission-only, 1099 independent contractor opportunity designed for individuals who want their earnings to reflect their sales performance.

* **Commission-based compensation:** Earn commissions for qualifying sales under the AisleRx commission plan.
* **Uncapped earning potential:** Your earnings can grow as you develop your territory and generate new business.
* **Flexible schedule:** Manage your prospecting and sales activities independently.
* **Territory development:** Build relationships and a network of independent pharmacies in your market.
* **Meaningful opportunity:** Help independent pharmacies explore innovative solutions in a changing healthcare landscape.

There is no guaranteed base salary or hourly wage. Earnings will depend on sales results and the terms of the commission agreement.

Why Join AisleRx?

Independent pharmacies are an important part of their communities, and they need innovative solutions to remain competitive and meet evolving customer needs.

By representing AisleRx, you can help pharmacy owners discover new opportunities while building your own sales business.

If you have the relationships, drive, and ability to open doors, this is an opportunity to turn your sales experience into a rewarding business development opportunity.

Apply Today

If you are a motivated sales professional with a passion for healthcare, strong relationship-building skills, and the drive to succeed in a commission-based environment, we want to hear from you.

Join AisleRx and help bring innovative telehealth solutions to independent pharmacies across New York and Ohio.

**AisleRx — Building partnerships with independent pharmacies.**

Pay: $1.00 - $400,000.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

We’re looking for a rare breed: self-motivated, fiercely competitive closers who want to eat what they kill and control their own financial ceiling.

This is not a boring desk job or a micro-managed corporate gig. We run direct-to-consumer field sales and promotional campaigns for Verizon Home Internet and Fios across high-traffic hubs in New York City and Westchester County. You will manage your territory independently, but lock step with a sharp team when we scale major deployments.

If you have a killer work ethic, know how to command a room in both English and Spanish, and treat sales like a professional sport, let's talk.

**What Your Day Looks Like:**

* **Run Your Own Hustle:** Total independence out in the field. You manage your rhythm, your execution, and your drive daily.
* **Team Power Moves:** While you operate most of the time independently, you’ll occasionally link up with the crew for high-volume team pushes and strategy alignments.
* **Direct Pitching:** Engage customers face-to-face at pre-mapped, high-traffic commercial and community hubs, pitching Verizon Home Internet and Fios services.

**The Non-Negotiables:**

* **A Reliable Car:** This is a mobile field role. You must have your own dependable vehicle to transport yourself and your setup gear to our daily locations.
* **The Killer Mentality:** You are hungry, resilient, competitive, and allergic to minimum-wage mindsets.
* **Sales Background:** Proven experience in direct sales, retail, canvassing, or high-pressure customer-facing environments.

**What’s In It For You:**

* **Uncapped Earning Potential:** Real producers pull **$1,500 + per week** based entirely on performance.

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager – Development & Construction
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**WHO WE ARE**

Equinox is a category of one, setting the global standard for luxury health, wellness, and hospitality. Our spaces are intentionally elevated, our standards uncompromising, and our expectations high. We attract people who take pride in excellence, care deeply about quality, and want to be part of something that feels different the moment you walk through the door.  
  
We are builders, operators, and innovators who believe great environments and meaningful human connection change lives. Diversity, belonging, and ownership aren’t slogans here, they’re how we work. At Equinox, colleagues don’t just support the business; they shape the future of wellness. Because for us, it’s not fitness. It’s life.

**WHAT WE DO**

We create premium, immersive experiences where performance, hospitality, design, and human connection converge—and every detail matters. This is not a traditional fitness environment. It is a place where high standards, accountability, and pride in craft define the work.  
  
Fueled by an entrepreneurial mindset, we trust our people with real responsibility and real impact. Growth is earned through action, learning is hands‑on, and careers are built by those who want to operate at the highest level. At Equinox, we don’t just offer opportunities—we offer long‑term pathways for people who want to do meaningful work in an environment that expects more and delivers more.

 **Job Description**

Equinox is looking for an Assistant Project Manager (APM) to help build our luxury fitness clubs. You will work across the entire project lifecycle, from early design and bidding through construction, and final handoff.

This is not just an administrative role. You will work alongside our Project Managers and Director of Construction, while actively coordinating with architects, engineers, general contractors, consultants, vendors, landlords, and internal teams to help keep projects organized, on schedule, and on budget. You will handle core project controls (budgets, schedules, RFIs, and submittals) while gaining the hands-on field experience needed to transition into running your own projects.

**What You’ll Do Daily**

* **Keep Projects on Schedule:** Track design deliverables, manage active logs for RFIs and submittals, and make sure design clarifications get answered before they delay the field.
* **Manage the Paperwork & Finances:** Maintain project budgets, cost reports, and schedules. Track contracts, change orders, and invoices, and review monthly contractor payment applications.
* **Support Preconstruction:** Assist with contractor bidding, bid leveling, scope reviews, and tracking long-lead materials.
* **On-Site Quality Control:** Travel to active construction sites to monitor progress. You will pay close attention to our high-end finishes, including custom millwork, specialty lighting, luxury tiling, and athletic flooring.
* **Drive Closeout & Handoff:** Manage punch lists, equipment commissioning, and closeout packages to ensure a seamless handoff to our Operations and Facilities teams.

  
**Qualifications**

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must-Haves:**

* **2 to 5 years** of experience in commercial construction, working for a general contractor, owner's representative, architecture firm, or engineering firm.
* **Strong technical fundamentals:** You can confidently read architectural/structural/MEP drawings and understand basic commercial construction sequencing.
* **Proven organizational skills:** You can manage multiple spreadsheets, logs, and competing priorities without letting details slip through the cracks.
* **Travel flexibility:** Ability to travel extensively throughout the U.S. and internationally to oversee active job sites.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

**Preferred Experience:**

* Prior experience in **hospitality, luxury retail, or high-end commercial interiors**.
* Proficiency with industry software like **Procore, Bluebeam, and Microsoft Project**, along with advanced Excel skills.
* OSHA 10/30 certification or LEED credentials.

**Growth & Culture**

We don't expect you to be an assistant forever. This role is deliberately structured as a stepping stone. As you show capability, you will take independent ownership of larger project scopes.

At Equinox, our clubs are the core of our brand. You’ll be building highly sophisticated, design-driven spaces alongside a seasoned team of real estate, architecture, and construction professionals.

**Pay Transparency:** $85K – $110K

 **Additional Information**

**AS A MEMBER OF THE EQUINOX TEAM YOU WILL RECEIVE:**

* We offer competitive salary, benefits, and industry leading commission opportunities for club employees
* Complimentary Club membership
* Perks and incentives with our products and services including Personal Training, Pilates, Spa and Shop

NOTE: This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure the proper operations of the department.

Equinox is an equal opportunity employer. For more information regarding our career opportunities, please visit one of our clubs or our website at https://careers.equinox.com/

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Must have a legal right to work in the United Kingdom.

jobs.description:
Veterinary Business Operations Assistant

**Animal Hospital of Morris Park – Bronx, NY**

Animal Hospital of Morris Park is a busy veterinary hospital that has served the Bronx community for more than 30 years. We are looking for a motivated **Veterinary Business Operations Assistant** to work directly with hospital management on projects that improve how the practice operates.

This is a great opportunity for a college student, recent graduate, or early-career professional interested in **business operations, finance, data, inventory, healthcare management, or process improvement.**

This is not a traditional receptionist position. We are looking for someone who enjoys organizing information, working with numbers and spreadsheets, researching problems, and finding better ways to get things done.

What You'll Work On

Projects may include:

* Creating spreadsheets, trackers, reports, and business summaries
* Organizing and analyzing operational and financial information
* Comparing vendor pricing, expenses, subscriptions, and purchasing options
* Assisting with inventory and cost-control projects
* Tracking recruiting, onboarding, training, and employee information
* Organizing policies, documents, and shared files
* Researching software, vendors, equipment, and business services
* Helping implement new systems and processes
* Supporting marketing and other business-development projects
* Following assigned projects from research through completion

Your role will often be to **collect information, organize it clearly, compare options, and prepare it for management review.** Final financial, staffing, and business decisions remain with management.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* Highly organized and detail-oriented
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets
* Good with numbers and data
* Curious and willing to research and solve problems
* Able to work independently
* Reliable and able to follow through
* Comfortable learning new software and systems
* Able to handle confidential business information

Previous veterinary experience is **not required**.

This position may be especially interesting for students or graduates studying **business, finance, accounting, business analytics, operations, supply chain, healthcare administration, economics, marketing, or entrepreneurship.**

What You'll Gain

You will work directly with hospital leadership and gain hands-on experience in areas such as business operations, financial analysis, inventory, vendor management, data reporting, recruiting, process improvement, software implementation, and healthcare administration.

We especially value people who see a messy process and think:

**"There has to be a better way to organize this."**

* **O2C (Order-to-Cash)**: Manages the customer journey from order to payment, driving smoother revenue processes.

* Perform other duties as assigned.

* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (Teams, Excel, Outlook) and comfort learning new systems required
* Experience coordinating meetings and event logistics preferred.

**The Packaging Program Today:** The Packaging program is one of PA's fastest-growing categories. With strong momentum and interest from our membership, we are building the team to ensure we stay ahead of the curve and exceed member expectations.

**THE ROLE**

As a Packaging Member Advisor, you will own a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts spanning a broad range of industries. Your members will range from independent companies to private equity-backed organizations and consulting relationships, reflecting the diversity of PA's membership base. You will serve as the primary point of contact for your members and a key driver of program adoption, realized value and impactful business outcomes. You will report to the Director of Packaging & Logistics and work in close partnership with others on the Packaging & Logistics team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Manage a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts with full accountability for engagement, retention, and delivered value.
* Develop deep knowledge of each member's organization structure, procurement contacts, site operations, packaging spend profile, and strategic priorities.
* Maintain a 3-wide, 3-deep relationship architecture — building relationships across procurement, operations, and finance at C-suite, director, and site manager levels.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) covering spend consolidated, savings delivered, opportunities identified, and forward-looking member needs.
* Identify and execute packaging optimization opportunities with our supplier partners, including SKU consolidation, packaging rationalization, vendor switching, and adoption tracking.
* Build strong working relationships with PA's packaging supplier partners to identify member-specific optimization levers.
* Utilize technology tools including PowerBI, Salesforce, Trumpet, AI, and PA proprietary software to document member interactions, track opportunity pipelines, and highlight risks.
* Support new member onboarding by participating in implementation handoffs and ensuring a seamless transition from the implementation process.

Requirements:

**Experience & Background**

* 3–5 years of experience in packaging, logistics, or supply chain account management — you have owned a book of business and been accountable for results.
* Direct experience working with or selling into manufacturing, industrial, or CPG companies; you understand how procurement decisions are made at complex organizations.
* Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder environments — you can operate effectively at the C-suite level and the site floor with equal ease.
* Demonstrated track record of building proactive client relationships, not reactive ones; you have examples of identifying and acting on opportunities before customers asked.
* Prior experience with PE-backed companies is a plus — you understand how private equity ownership shapes procurement priorities and decision timelines.
* Exposure to packaging distribution, manufacturing, or GPO/indirect spend environments (Uline, Veritiv, 48Forty, Shorr, or similar) is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Analytical fluency: you are comfortable in Salesforce, Excel, and data tools — you use data to manage your accounts proactively, not reactively.
* Strong project management instincts: you can run a QBR, manage an optimization initiative, track deliverables, and hold suppliers and members accountable to commitments.
* Clear, confident communicator — written, verbal, and in presentations. You do not over-explain; you drive to decisions.
* Entrepreneurial mindset: you bring a sense of ownership and urgency to your work. You do not wait to be told what to do.
* Collaborative teammate: you escalate intelligently, share knowledge freely, and make the people around you better.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree from a competitive program required. Strong academic performance.
* MBA or advanced degree is a plus, but track record and results matter more.

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation package
* Company subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) match
* Employee Assistance Program
* State-of-the-art, tech-enabled office near the Battery (Home of the Atlanta Braves)
* Flexible / hybrid work culture

jobs.title: Named Account Manager

In this role, you’ll own the strategy, customer relationships and commercial growth of a portfolio of strategic accounts. As a trusted advisor to customer executives on AI strategy, you’ll help shape their ambitions, prioritize high-impact opportunities and develop a roadmap for enterprise-wide adoption. You’ll align internal teams to deliver measurable business outcomes, lead strategic expansion opportunities and proactively manage risks to customer success and the long-term partnership.

You will use customer usage, adoption, and consumption data to identify growth opportunities, expand use cases, and increase revenue across assigned accounts

This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic consultative selling skills with strong account management, commercial judgment, and a genuine interest in helping customers realize measurable value from AI.

Responsibilities

Account Ownership and Customer Relationships

  

* Own and actively manage a portfolio of existing Strategic accounts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned customers.
* Develop a clear understanding of each customer’s business priorities, AI strategy, use cases, organizational structure, and success criteria.
* Build strong relationships with customers across multiple levels, including senior executives, decision-makers, procurement teams, champions and users.
* Establish a consistent engagement cadence through discovery meetings, business reviews, strategic check-ins, and proactive outreach.
* Create and maintain strategic account plans outlining customer goals, key stakeholders, adoption opportunities, commercial potential, risks, and next actions.

Growth and Expansion

  

* Identify, develop, and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities within the existing customer portfolio.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, account activity, and business priorities to uncover expansion opportunities.
* Recommend appropriate products, features, commercial structures, and use cases based on the customer’s needs.
* Build and manage a healthy expansion pipeline while maintaining accurate forecasts and clear next steps.
* Lead the full sales cycle from including discovery, solution positioning, objection handling, negotiation, and deal progression.
* Consistently achieve or exceed expansion revenue, pipeline generation, adoption, and account engagement targets.

Adoption, Retention, and Risk Management

  

* Help customers maximize the value they receive from the company’s products and services.
* Proactively identify accounts with low adoption, limited engagement, unresolved issues, or potential churn risk.
* Develop clear action plans to improve adoption, rebuild engagement, and protect the long-term customer relationship.
* Identify opportunities to introduce additional products and use cases that support the customer’s evolving business objectives.
* Support renewal readiness by maintaining strong account health and ensuring commercial risks are identified early.
* Gather and communicate customer feedback, product gaps, competitive insights, and recurring challenges to internal stakeholders.

Customer Issue Coordination

  

* Take ownership of the customer experience when commercial, billing, product, contractual, or operational issues arise.
* Assess customer concerns, determine their business impact, and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process, including timelines, progress updates, and next steps.
* Escalate high-impact or time-sensitive issues through the correct internal channels.
* Ensure customer concerns are followed through to resolution while maintaining trust and accountability.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements that can reduce customer friction.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  

* Collaborate closely with Management, Support, Solutions, Finance, Legal, Product, and Operations teams.
* Coordinate internal resources to deliver a consistent and seamless customer experience.
* Ensure clear handoffs, ownership, and accountability when multiple teams are involved in an account.
* Share customer insights and commercial opportunities with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Contribute to team best practices, enablement sessions, account reviews, and continuous process improvement.

CRM and Operational Excellence

  

* Maintain accurate and timely records of customer interactions, account plans, opportunities, risks, and next steps in Salesforce or another CRM platform.
* Keep expansion opportunities, pipeline stages, close dates, and forecasts current and reliable.
* Prepare account updates and communicate progress, blockers, and support needs to leadership.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of product capabilities, pricing, commercial policies, customer use cases, and the competitive landscape.
* Follow established sales, contracting, forecasting, escalation, and customer communication processes.

  

Basic Qualifications:

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Minimum of 2 years of experience in B2B account management, customer success, inside sales, renewals, or consumption-based selling within a SaaS, cloud, AI, or technology environment.

* Demonstrated experience growing existing accounts through usage-led, consumption-based, or land-and-expand sales motions

As the Assistant Community Manager, you will play a vital role in the delinquency and collection of rent to optimize the property's cash flow and financial position. As an Assistant Community Manager, you will manage all phases of the operations, including personnel, leasing, maintenance, financial, administration & risk management in the absence of the Community Manager. As an on-site leader, you will supervise all aspects of the property and staff to ensure compliance with the company's policies and procedures, safety and fair housing guidelines, and liability concerns.

* *Affordable Housing Accreditation (HCCP, HCP-E, COS, BOS, TCS, CPO) or other applicable designations in affordable programs are preferred but not required.*

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

Financial Management

* Responsible for posting all payments and income received from all applicants, current residents, and non-current residents accurately, timely, and efficiently.
* Responsible for processing and reconciling daily all account receivables.
* Monitor and follow up on bad debt to include preparation of late notices, resident and guarantor contact, and filing evictions.
* Responsible for helping the property meet budgeted revenues, expenses, and Net Operating Income.
* Responsible for posting of all charges to resident and non-current resident accounts; to also include bill back of utilities where applicable.
* Responsible for all end-of-the-month closing procedures and reporting.
* Maintain accurate and organized records; audit resident files to ensure accurate records.
* Responsible for walking units and posting all move-out charges, statements, and security deposit refunds.

Personnel Management

* Regular/daily onsite attendance is required
* Use consistent techniques & company directives to screen, hire, train, coach, and develop onsite staff.
* Ensure the effectiveness of staff through ongoing training, coaching, counseling, and guidance in compliance with Asset training benchmarks.
* Promote harmony and quality job performance of staff through support and effective leadership.
* Ensure staff compliance and consistency with Company policies and procedures.
* Strategic Leasing Management
* Ensure staff leasing techniques are effective in obtaining closure, follow-up procedures met, signing/documentation of leases, and reporting systems are accurate and up to date.
* Implement marketing strategies & systems put in place by the annual marketing plan.
* Deal with resident complaints, concerns, and requests to ensure resident satisfaction.
* Develop and implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletter, etc.)
* Effectively show, lease, and move in prospective residents.

Administrative Management

* Manage excellent customer service and monitor service request turnaround and responsiveness of maintenance staff.

* Assist with supervision of all business functions related to operations.
* Plan for and utilize property resources, equipment, and supplies economically (i.e., obtaining bids/pricing from vendors, suppliers, contractors, dealing with inadequate service, etc.)

The Partner Manager is responsible for managing, retaining, and growing a portfolio of advertising partners across agency and/or direct advertiser relationships. This role blends consultative account management, digital marketing expertise, and data-driven optimization to deliver measurable business outcomes and long-term partner success.

As a trusted advisor, the Partner Manager develops a strong understanding of partner business objectives and translates campaign performance into actionable insights and strategic recommendations. The role requires strong stakeholder management, fluency in digital advertising KPIs, and the ability to manage multiple active campaigns while driving revenue growth and partner satisfaction.

Partner Managers collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Operations, and Leadership teams to align strategy, support revenue forecasting, and contribute to continuous process improvement. Depending on role designation, the Partner Manager may support digital managed growth programs, agency portfolios, or direct advertiser accounts.

Key Responsibilities:

  

* Serve as the primary point of contact and strategic advisor for direct advertiser partners.
* Own the end-to-end partner lifecycle, including onboarding, activation, optimization, renewal, and expansion.
* Conduct consultative discussions to translate advertiser business objectives into effective digital advertising strategies.
* Independently identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities to drive revenue growth.
* Manage a portfolio of new and existing digital advertising partners, ensuring strong campaign performance and partner satisfaction.
* Retain and grow revenue by identifying upsell, cross-sell, reactivation, and expansion opportunities.
* Develop a deep understanding of partner business goals and translate performance data into strategic recommendations.
* Track, analyze, and report on key advertising and business metrics, including CPA, ROI, ROAS, CPC, and conversion performance.
* Optimize and troubleshoot digital advertising campaigns to improve outcomes and drive long-term partner value.
* Maintain accurate account records, partner communications, and pipeline activity within CRM systems.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Operations, and Leadership teams to align strategy and performance goals.
* Communicate product updates, beta programs, and feature enhancements to partners and internal stakeholders.
* Consistently meet or exceed individual and team performance KPIs and revenue targets.
* Contribute to a collaborative team environment by supporting peers and sharing best practices.

  

Basic Qualifications:

  

* Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Media Studies, Advertising, Public Relations, Communications, Business Administration, or Sales OR
* 1 year experience in Digital Marketing, Sales, and/or Account Management

Preferred Qualifications:

  

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Experience managing client, customer, or partner relationships in a performance-driven environment.
* Familiarity with digital advertising platforms and performance marketing concepts.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, metric-oriented environment.
* Comfort working with data, performance metrics, and insights to inform decisions and recommendations.
* Experience using CRM tools (e.g. Salesforce) to manage accounts, pipelines, and reporting.

* Hands-on experience managing or analyzing campaigns on online advertising platforms (e.g., Meta, Google, Pinterest, TikTok, Snapchat, X).
* Experience working with advertising agencies (AGY) or managing direct advertiser portfolios (DIR).
* Strong understanding of digital marketing fundamentals, funnel strategy, attribution models, and media KPIs.
* Proven ability to meet or exceed sales, growth, or retention targets.
* Strong analytical, storytelling, and insight-generation skills.
* Experience leading virtual or in-person consultative conversations.
* Proficiency with Excel, Salesforce, and Google Workspace or Microsoft Office tools.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
**About Gallagher Security**

Gallagher Security is a global technology leader trusted by organizations to protect people, assets, and operations in complex environments. We’re looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative who enjoys connecting with prospective customers, generating demand, and creating opportunities that support our continued growth.

**The Opportunity**

As an SDR, you will engage in our lead generation strategy that focuses on research, outreach, prospecting, outbound demand generation, inbound, and lead qualification via all our social media and market intelligence platforms. This position will help turn leads into qualified opportunities by partnering with marketing and sales to create and execute on program and outbound lead generation campaigns. This will be accomplished by conducting a mix of communication tactics such as email and outbound calls, with the ultimate goal of uncovering new or existing sales leads as well as identifying and generating sales opportunities through both inbound and outbound calling activities.

Reporting to the Sales Development Team Lead, you’ll work cross functionally with sales, marketing, and engineering, and as one of the first people a prospect speaks with, you’ll set the tone for the sales cycle that follows.

This is a hybrid role, with an expected 2–3 days per week in our Canton office and the remainder working from home. Travel is minimal.

**What You’ll Do**

* Follow up on inbound marketing leads and qualify interest through phone and email conversations, giving prospects the right information at the right time.

* Build target prospect lists, penetrate key accounts, and cold call prospects sourced from a range of channels.

* Profile strategic accounts, identify key decision makers, and research business requirements to start the sales cycle.

* Run discovery and qualification calls and deliver high level, solution oriented presentations on Gallagher products and services.

* Understand each prospect’s needs and tailor your outreach to suit.

* Nurture leads until they’re ready to speak with a Business Development Manager or Regional Sales Manager, then set appointments, schedule on-site demos, and hand off qualified opportunities.

* Drive attendance at webinars and live seminars and set meetings for conferences.

* Keep accurate prospect, activity, and lead qualification records in our CRM to ensure strong follow through.

* Share feedback and new ideas to continually improve our sales development process.

* Build your knowledge of the access control, perimeter protection, and intrusion detection markets, and clearly articulate the value Gallagher Security brings.

* Shadow Business Development Managers and, when needed, travel with Outside Sales to meet in-region partners and end users.

**What You’ll Bring**

You’re a confident, energetic communicator who enjoys starting conversations, thinks outside the box, and brings real tenacity to reaching your goals.

* 2+ years of successful experience in inside sales, demand generation, telemarketing, and/or customer service.

* A four year college degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent experience; a bachelor’s degree in business or a related area is preferred.

* Demonstrated success in prospecting and experience using CRM systems; experience with sales outreach platforms is a plus.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong active listening, emotional intelligence, and a positive, energetic phone presence.

* The ability to explain complex issues clearly and hold relaxed but informative two way conversations with prospects.

* The ability to manage multiple requests and priorities at once while achieving goals for your territory or accounts.

* A self-motivated approach and sense of urgency. You act without waiting to be told and work well under pressure.

* A team player mindset, with the flexibility to work independently and collaborate with a distributed sales team in a fast paced, changing environment.

* High integrity, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to building a successful company.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**What We Offer**

* Career development opportunities, including the chance to learn from experienced sales professionals and build skills for future advancement.

* A collaborative, cross functional environment where your ideas and contributions can help improve our sales approach.

* The opportunity to represent a respected global security technology company and contribute directly to regional growth.

**Apply Now**

If you’re ready to build relationships, generate demand, and help create new opportunities for Gallagher Security, apply today.

**Job Title:****Inside Sales Representative**

**Reports to:****Regional Director**

**Location:****Marietta, GA**

**Department:****Sales**

**Role:****Non-exempt**

**Experience:****2+ years**

  

**About us:**

Founded in 1991, JAN-PRO is one of the world's leading commercial cleaning franchise organizations. Through a network of more than 125 Regional Developers and over 10,000 independently owned Certified Business Owners, JAN-PRO delivers industry-leading commercial cleaning and disinfecting services to businesses across North America and internationally. JAN-PRO is committed to helping entrepreneurs achieve business ownership while providing customers with exceptional service, innovative cleaning solutions, and industry-leading support. As part of the Empower Brands family, JAN-PRO continues to build on its legacy of operational excellence, trusted partnerships, and franchisee success. Empower Brands is a portfolio company of MidOcean Partners, a leading private equity firm with a strong track record of investing in successful, growth-focused franchise businesses.

  

**Position Overview:**

The Inside Sales Representative is responsible for generating new commercial cleaning business opportunities through high-volume outbound prospecting, lead qualification, and appointment setting. This results-driven position plays a critical role in building the sales pipeline by identifying prospective customers, engaging decision-makers, and securing qualified appointments for Outside Sales Representatives.

  

Working closely with the regional sales team, the Inside Sales Representative communicates JAN-PRO's value proposition, maintains accurate prospect information, and consistently meets established activity and appointment-setting goals. Success requires a proactive sales approach, strong communication skills, resilience, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

  

**Core Responsibilities:**

**Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation**

* Conduct high-volume outbound prospecting, targeting approximately 125–150 quality calls daily to generate new commercial cleaning opportunities.

* Research prospective businesses, identify key decision-makers, and develop targeted outreach strategies within assigned markets.

* Communicate JAN-PRO's commercial cleaning services and value proposition to prospective customers.

* Navigate gatekeepers, address objections, and identify customer needs through effective questioning and active listening.

* Maintain consistent follow-up with prospective customers to develop qualified sales opportunities.

  

**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting**

* Qualify prospective customers based on business needs, service requirements, decision-making authority, and sales readiness.

* Schedule approximately 25 qualified sales appointments monthly for Outside Sales Representatives.

* Coordinate with Outside Sales Representatives to ensure accurate prospect information and effective appointment handoffs.

* Monitor appointment attendance, quality, and conversion results to improve lead-generation effectiveness.

* Build professional relationships with prospective customers that support future sales opportunities.

  

**Sales Performance & CRM Management**

* Consistently achieve established outbound activity, appointment-setting, and lead-generation objectives.

* Maintain accurate and timely CRM records, including prospect information, outreach activity, follow-up schedules, and appointment details.

* Monitor individual performance metrics, including call volume, decision-maker conversations, appointments scheduled, appointment attendance, and conversion rates.

* Partner with sales leadership to identify opportunities to improve outreach strategies, prospect engagement, and overall sales performance.

  

**Sales Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with Outside Sales Representatives and regional leadership to align prospecting efforts with business development priorities.

* Participate in sales training, coaching, and call reviews to strengthen communication, objection handling, and conversion effectiveness.

* Apply feedback and continuously refine prospecting techniques, sales messaging, and follow-up strategies.

* Contribute to a collaborative, accountable, and results-focused sales environment.

  

**Critical Skills & Attributes:**

* Strong outbound prospecting and cold-calling skills with the ability to engage prospective customers and generate qualified sales opportunities.

* Excellent verbal communication, active listening, persuasion, and objection-handling skills.

* Competitive, self-motivated, and results-oriented approach with the resilience to maintain consistent performance in a high-rejection sales environment.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage high-volume outreach and follow-up activities.

* Coachable and adaptable, with a willingness to incorporate feedback and continuously improve performance.

* Strong relationship-building skills with the ability to work collaboratively with Outside Sales Representatives and regional leadership.

* Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, and sales tracking tools.

  

**Required Experience & Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of B2B outbound phone sales, prospecting, or appointment-setting experience.

* Demonstrated success in high-volume outbound calling and generating qualified sales appointments.

* Experience engaging business decision-makers, overcoming objections, and qualifying sales opportunities.

* Experience using CRM systems to document sales activities, manage follow-ups, and track performance.

* Ability to consistently meet established sales activity, appointment-setting, and performance expectations.

* Ability to work full-time from the assigned regional office.
