jobs.description:
**Job description:**

Socomec Group (Socomec) is a global leader in electrical equipment engineering and manufacturing, specialized in low voltage energy performance. Socomec North America (NAM) is Socomec’s organization overseeing all operations in North America.

We are seeking a Customer Success Specialist to join our team to lead and optimize the execution of customer orders by serving as a subject matter expert and key escalation point for order management, invoicing, and customer service activities. The Inside Sales / Customer Service Coordinator drives performance, ensures process consistency, and supports continuous improvement across the order lifecycle while coordinating cross-functional teams to deliver a high-quality customer experience.

This role is responsible for proactively preventing issues, improving operational processes, and mentoring team members to enhance overall team capability and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers and sales teams, managing inquiries and providing proactive updates throughout the order lifecycle
* Oversee and manage complex, high-value/high-volume, or project-based orders end-to-end, proactively monitoring timelines, risks, and dependencies to ensure alignment across stakeholders and on-time delivery
* Lead cross-functional coordination across Production, Engineering, and Supply-chain to resolve issues and ensure alignment on priorities and commitments
* Own same-day shipment and invoicing alignment by ensuring invoices are issued upon shipment, eliminating delays and improving billing cycle performance
* Lead investigation and resolution of invoicing discrepancies, credit notes, and billing issues, ensuring accuracy prior to month-end close
* Own data integrity across order lifecycle, identifying gaps and implementing controls to improve accuracy and reporting reliability
* Analyze operational data (order backlog, invoicing status, shipment tracking) to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities and drive corrective actions
* Lead and manage complex RMAs, shipping damage cases, and customer recovery efforts, including root cause analysis and process improvements
* Serve as the subject matter expert for ERP systems, troubleshooting complex issues, supporting team members, and ensuring effective system utilization
* Lead ERP testing, validation, and deployment activities, ensuring smooth implementation of system updates and minimizing operational disruption
* Effectively prioritizes orders, escalations, and workload to ensure alignment with business priorities and timely fulfillment of customer commitments
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring operational issues, implementing corrective actions and preventing recurrence through process standardization
* Develop and maintain documentation, best practices, and training materials to improve team efficiency and consistency
* Mentor, coach, and train junior and intermediate team members, providing guidance on order management, ERP usage, and issue resolution
* Support team workload balancing and act as a go-to resource during peak periods or complex operational scenarios
* Provide input into performance tracking, KPIs, and process improvements, supporting continuous improvement and team performance
* Perform other duties as required to support operational excellence and business objectives
* Coordinate outbound shipments with internal teams, warehouses, carriers, and freight forwarders to support customer delivery requirements

Essential Qualifications, Experience, And Skills

* Completion of a college or university program in business administration, technical, or related field is preferred
* 5+ years customer service, or order management roles within a B2B or manufacturing environment (preferred)
* Strong experience managing complex or project-based orders and working in cross-functional environments
* Advanced knowledge of ERP systems and Microsoft Office tools
* Advanced problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex operational and customer issues independently
* Strong understanding of order lifecycle processes and downstream impacts (production, supply-chain, invoicing, customer delivery)
* Ability to anticipate risks and proactively prevent issues before they impact customers
* Strong analytical skills to interpret data and drive operational improvements
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to handle sensitive customer situations and escalations
* Ability to lead cross-functional coordination and influence stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail and ownership of data accuracy and process quality
* Ability to coach, mentor, and support team development
* High level of organization and time management in a fast-paced environment

Additional Requirements

* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment with multiple concurrent priorities and deadlines
* Daily use of ERP systems and Microsoft Office tools is required
* Strong adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), data accuracy standards, and documentation requirements
* Frequent interaction and coordination with cross-functional teams including Sales, Engineering, Production and Finance
* Role is a hybrid office-based with no regular travel requirements
* Ability to manage administrative tasks requiring attention to detail, including data entry, order processing, and document management

Compensation range: $50,000 – $55,000 USD

jobs.title: Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising Specialist
jobs.description:
Company: Motus Nova

Job Type: Full-Time

Pay: $65,000–$85,000 per year

Location: Atlanta, GA (In-Person)

Schedule: Monday–Friday

**About Motus Nova**

Motus Nova is an innovative healthcare technology company dedicated to transforming neurological rehabilitation through advanced robotic therapy solutions.

Our mission is to make high-quality rehabilitation more accessible to individuals recovering from strokes, brain injuries, and other neurological conditions. Through our innovative Motus Hand and Motus Foot devices, we empower patients to take an active role in their recovery from the comfort of their own homes.

As we continue to grow, we are seeking a creative, analytical, and results-driven Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising Specialist to join our team and help expand our reach nationwide.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Digital Marketing & Paid Advertising Specialist to develop, manage, and optimize our digital advertising campaigns across multiple platforms.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with Google Ads, Facebook/Instagram Ads, paid search, lead generation, and performance marketing.

This role will focus on increasing brand awareness, generating qualified patient leads, improving advertising performance, and maximizing return on marketing investment.

You will play a key role in developing digital marketing strategies that connect patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals with Motus Nova's rehabilitation technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Digital Advertising & Campaign Management*

* Develop, launch, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and other digital platforms.
* Manage daily advertising operations, including campaign budgets, targeting, bidding strategies, and performance optimization.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience targeting to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase qualified leads while reducing cost per acquisition.
* Monitor advertising performance and make data-driven adjustments to maximize results.
* Conduct A/B testing on advertisements, landing pages, headlines, and creative assets.
* Identify new advertising opportunities and digital channels to expand customer acquisition.

***Marketing Strategy & Lead Generation***

* Develop and execute digital marketing strategies aligned with company growth objectives.
* Create targeted marketing campaigns designed to reach stroke survivors, individuals with neurological conditions, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
* Optimize marketing funnels, landing pages, and lead-generation processes.
* Assist with email marketing campaigns, retargeting strategies, and customer engagement initiatives.

Gallagher Security is a global technology leader trusted by organizations to protect people, assets, and operations in complex environments. We’re looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative who enjoys connecting with prospective customers, generating demand, and creating opportunities that support our continued growth.

**The Opportunity**

As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll play an important role in our lead generation strategy, supporting the Canadian and U.S. markets. You’ll research target accounts, conduct outreach and outbound demand generation, respond to inbound interest, prospect across social media and market intelligence platforms, and qualify leads through email and inbound and outbound calls.

You’ll partner with sales and marketing to create and execute program and outbound lead generation campaigns, uncover new and existing sales leads, and turn early interest into qualified opportunities. Working cross functionally with sales, marketing, and technical teams, you’ll help create a positive first impression and build momentum throughout the sales cycle.

This is a hybrid role with 2-3 days in the Canton Atlanta office.

**What You’ll Do**

* Follow up on inbound marketing leads, qualify interest, and provide prospects with the right information at the right time.

* Research target markets, build prospect lists, identify key decision makers, and develop a clear understanding of customer requirements.

* Generate new opportunities through outbound calls, email, social media, campaigns, webinars, seminars, and conferences.

* Conduct discovery and qualification conversations, communicate Gallagher Security’s value, and deliver high level, solution oriented presentations.

* Schedule qualified appointments and demonstrations, then hand opportunities to Business Development Managers or Regional Sales Managers.

* Nurture prospects until they are ready to engage with sales, building trusted relationships as an early point of contact.

* Maintain accurate prospect, activity, and qualification records in the CRM and ensure effective follow through across the sales cycle.

* Collaborate with sales, marketing, and technical colleagues to improve campaigns, refine outreach, and support regional growth.

* Develop knowledge of access control, perimeter protection, intrusion detection, and Gallagher Security’s wider product offering.

**What You’ll Bring**

This role **requires professional fluency in both French and English** to communicate effectively with prospective customers across Canada. **Fluency in both languages is an essential requirement for the position.**

You’re an energetic, self motivated communicator who enjoys opening conversations, understanding customer needs, and working with others to turn interest into genuine sales opportunities.

* **Fluency in both French and English is required to support prospective customers across Canada.**

* **2+ years of successful experience in inside sales, demand generation, telemarketing, customer service, or a related field.**

* A four year college degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent relevant experience; a bachelor’s degree in business or a related area is preferred.

* Strong written and verbal communication, active listening, and the confidence to hold informative two way conversations with prospects.

* Demonstrated prospecting ability and experience using CRM systems; familiarity with sales outreach platforms is an advantage.

* The ability to explain complex topics clearly, tailor outreach to customer needs, and manage multiple priorities in a fast paced environment.

* A collaborative, flexible, and responsive approach, with the ability to work independently and support a distributed team.

* A diligent work ethic, high integrity, resilience, initiative, and a strong focus on achieving goals and key deliverables.

* Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**What We Offer**

* Career development opportunities, including the chance to learn from experienced sales professionals and build skills for future advancement.

* A collaborative, cross functional environment where your ideas and contributions can help improve our sales approach.

* The opportunity to represent a respected global security technology company and contribute directly to regional growth.

**Apply Now**

If you’re ready to build relationships, generate demand, and help create new opportunities for Gallagher Security, apply today.

jobs.description:
**Marketing Services | Chicago, IL | Full-Time | Local Travel Required**

**Join us — and do work that matters.**

We're a passionate team of change-makers, diverse thinkers, and problem-solvers. Our purpose: ensuring full access to quality living and championing the power of inclusivity. We proudly serve over 7,000 individuals with disabilities and behavioral health challenges, including those who are Deaf, DeafBlind, and Hard of Hearing.

If you're not looking for just any job — if you're ready to build a career where your work directly supports that mission — Anixter Center is the place for you.

**About the Role**

As our Community Outreach Manager, you'll be the face of Anixter Center to the schools and agencies that support young people and adults with IDD and mental health needs. You'll build and sustain a robust referral network that connects individuals and families to our transition and community-based services, and you'll make sure every referral ends in a successful connection. You'll be the primary point of contact for Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, Integrated Community Supports agencies (ISCs), Community Service Organizations (CSOs), and Community Alternative Unlimited units (CAUs) across Chicagoland, and you'll partner closely with Intake, Case Management, program staff, and Marketing/Communications.

This is a full-time, exempt role based in Chicago, with regular local travel throughout the Chicagoland area. A flexible schedule is required, which may include evenings and weekends as necessary.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and grow a referral pipeline by developing strong, lasting relationships with Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs.
* Conduct regular outreach through site visits, presentations, and one-on-one meetings with school staff, coordinators, and case managers.
* Represent Anixter Center at IEP/transition planning meetings, school fairs, community events, and networking functions to raise awareness of our programs.
* Serve as a go-to resource on our transition, IDD, mental health, and Deaf/DeafBlind/Hard of Hearing services, helping partners understand eligibility, intake, and program fit.
* Set up and maintain clear referral pathways with partners, documenting how to refer, who to contact, and what to expect at each step.
* Track every referral from first contact to enrollment in our CRM, and follow up with partners and families to close the loop. Work with Intake, Case Management, and program staff to make each handoff smooth.
* Develop outreach materials with Marketing/Communications, monitor referral trends and outcomes, and share what you learn about gaps, underserved communities, and new partnership opportunities with leadership.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Education, Human Services, Public Health, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (preferred).
* 2+ years of experience in community outreach, community development, referral or care coordination, case management, special education, or transition services (preferred).
* Working knowledge of the IDD and/or mental health service systems in Illinois, including ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs, and familiarity with PUNS (Prioritization of Urgency of Need for Services) and the IEP/transition planning process.
* Excellent relationship-building, networking, and communication skills, with the confidence to engage school administrators, educators, and agency partners, and strong organizational skills with a CRM or referral-tracking database.
* A valid driver's license, willingness to travel locally throughout Chicagoland, and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as necessary.
* An existing network in Chicagoland special education, transition schools, or DHS/DRS-affiliated service coordination agencies; experience working with individuals who are Deaf, DeafBlind, or Hard of Hearing (ASL a plus); and nonprofit, healthcare, or education-adjacent partnerships experience are all a plus.
* A genuine commitment to nonprofit, mission-driven work.

**Benefits**

Anixter Center offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, and generous paid time off and holidays.

**Why Anixter Center**

You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team committed to inclusion and accessibility, where relationships and follow-through translate directly into people getting the right supports at the right time. We offer a mission you can feel good about and the chance to be the connection between families and the services they need.

*Anixter Center is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing people with disabilities.*

**Ready to make an impact? Apply today with your resume and a cover letter describing your experience building partnerships or referral networks and your interest in our mission.**

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator (12-Week Contract)
jobs.description:
**About Curfew Labs**  
Curfew Labs builds software that makes work easier. Our flagship, Curfew Suite, is a family of connected business apps for time, expenses, books, projects and signatures on one account. We build quiet, dependable tools that do the tedious, load-bearing work so people don’t have to worry when they step away.

**The role**  
A 12-week contract to find out where our marketing should go next. This is an analytics role more than a creative one. You’ll set up and run paid campaigns across our advertising channels, make sure every click and sign-up can be traced back to where it came from, and measure what each new customer costs us to win and what they’re worth. Then you’ll tell us, with evidence, which bets to make. Our team handles the creative; you’ll brief it, test it and say what’s working. Expect 20 to 40 hours a week, set together at the start, and a hybrid schedule from our Chicago office.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and own our tracking. Set a consistent UTM convention for every link and campaign, and put conversion tracking, ad platform pixels and analytics events in place. The goal is clean attribution from first click to paying customer.
* Plan, launch and manage paid campaigns on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram, TikTok, and OpenAI’s ChatGPT ads
* Track customer acquisition cost (CAC) by channel, campaign and audience, alongside conversion rates, return on ad spend and early lifetime value
* Analyze the customer lifecycle, from first visit to sign-up, activation and retention, using funnels and cohorts, and find the patterns behind who stays
* Design and run tests on audiences, offers, landing pages and budgets, with a clear hypothesis and read-out for each
* Build a simple dashboard and a weekly report that say plainly what’s working, what isn’t, and where to move spend
* Brief our team on creative and landing pages based on what the data shows
* Leave the tracking, the dashboard and a written playbook in good order, so the work carries on after the contract

**What you bring**

* Two or more years in performance or growth marketing, ideally for software or online services, with real responsibility for budgets and results
* Hands-on experience with Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram) and TikTok Ads, and experience with or a strong interest in ChatGPT ads
* Strong command of UTMs, conversion tracking, pixels and attribution, and of tools such as Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager or similar
* A track record of measuring CAC, return on ad spend and lifetime value, and of turning the numbers into decisions
* Experience with funnel, cohort and retention analysis; comfort with spreadsheets, and SQL a plus
* A habit of testing before scaling, and of reporting results honestly, including the ones that didn’t work
* A very organized way of working

**Contract details**

* 12 weeks, starting as soon as the right person is found
* 20 to 40 hours a week, agreed at the start based on campaign volume
* Hybrid: part of the week in our Chicago office, the rest remote
* $30 to $45 an hour

We work in the office and are open to hybrid schedules.

**Why Curfew Labs**  
We’re building business software around a simple idea: applications should work together naturally, so people spend less time managing tools and more time on the work that matters. People and AI work side by side at every stage of how we build and run the company: people set the direction and remain accountable, and AI helps us move faster. In this role, your analysis will shape where Curfew Labs invests next. Learn more about us at curfewlabs.com.

Pay: $30.00 - $45.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60625

Drip City Plumbing, Drain & Sewer is a new, ambitious plumbing company serving the Chicagoland area.

We're starting small, but our vision is BIG. We want to build Drip City into one of Chicago's most recognized plumbing, sewer, and drain companies, competing with established brands

jobs.title: Inbound Sales Coordinator
jobs.description:
Americaneagle.com is looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Inbound Sales Coordinator to join our growing Business Development team. This is an entry-level role built for someone who wants to start a career in sales and learn the business from the ground up.
  
  
As the first point of contact for prospective clients, you’ll handle inquiries that come in through phone calls, web form submissions, live chat, email, and internal referrals. You’ll respond quickly, learn to qualify each inquiry, route it to the right Sales Representative, and make sure every handoff includes the context needed to start the conversation well. Along the way, you’ll get hands-on experience with Salesforce, sales qualification, and the full sales process, plus training and coaching from experienced sales and business development professionals.
  
  
This is a great fit for someone who is curious, eager to learn, and energized by talking with people. Success in this role is measured by speed-to-lead, qualification accuracy, data quality, and how well inbound inquiries turn into real opportunities. Strong performers will have a clear path to grow into a Business Development Representative or other sales roles.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  

* Serve as the first point of contact for inbound inquiries across phone, web forms, live chat, email, and internal channels, providing a professional and responsive experience
* Respond to new inquiries promptly, following established response-time standards
* Qualify inbound leads by asking questions to understand the prospect’s needs, project scope, timeline, and budget, using the qualification process you’ll be trained on
* Route qualified leads to the right Sales Representative based on assignment
* Write clear, concise handoff notes that summarize each prospect’s needs and conversation history
* Schedule and coordinate initial calls between prospects and Sales Representatives
* Enter and maintain accurate lead, contact, account, and opportunity records in Salesforce, including logging activity and keeping data clean
* Direct non-sales inquiries (existing client support, vendor solicitations, job seekers) to the right internal teams
* Follow up with leads who haven’t responded or aren’t ready to move forward yet
* Support sales operations projects and other team initiatives during slower inbound periods, such as Salesforce data cleanup, list building, research, and reporting
* Take part in ongoing sales training, shadow sales calls, and build your knowledge of our services and the digital industry

  
**Requirements**
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Sales, Communications, Marketing, or a related field
* 0–2 years of professional experience in a Sales or Business Development role, with a genuine interest in building a career in sales
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a friendly, professional presence on the phone and in writing
* Strong listening skills and natural curiosity, with the ability to identify prospect needs and ask effective qualifying questions
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to juggle multiple tasks, keep information accurate, and stay composed in a fast-paced environment
* Self-motivated, competitive, and results-driven, with a coachable attitude and an eagerness to learn and grow
* Ability to juggle multiple tasks and stay composed in a fast-paced environment
* Collaborative team player who works well with others
* Comfortable learning new software; experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus but not required
* Interest in digital marketing, web design and development, or technology is a plus
* Professional appearance and demeanor is expected

Americaneagle.com provides its employees with an energetic work environment and opportunities to further develop their skills. Our dedication to growing our development team is how we can produce excellent sites and applications for our clients. We do all of this while maintaining a family value focus and pushing for a good work-life balance. The US-based salary range for this full-time position is $60,000-$75,000 per year. Within this range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. At Americaneagle.com, we are committed to providing a comprehensive benefits package, a positive work environment, company activities and more.

In this role, you’ll partner with clients across the CRE industry to help them promote, market, and grow their brands through one of the most dynamic B2B media platforms in the country — and in the room at 400+ live events a year.***

***This isn’t a dead-end entry role. There’s a clear path to Business Manager and a genuine culture of developing and promoting from within. If you’re ambitious and coachable, this is the kind of place where your first job becomes your career.***

***This is a hybrid role based in our Chicago office (24 East Washington St.), in-office 3–4 days a week. We welcome candidates coming straight out of college or bringing experience from internships, coursework, or early professional roles.***

**BISNOW OVERVIEW**  
Bisnow is the leading B2B media platform powering the commercial real estate industry. We connect CRE professionals through award-winning news, high-impact events, marketing solutions, recruiting services, and sales enablement tools that drive real business results.  
  
With 1.7M+ subscribers and 400+ events annually across 47 markets in the U.S., Canada, the UK, Ireland, and the Netherlands, we don’t just cover the industry, we help move it forward.  
We inform. We connect. We create opportunities that turn into deals. Global mindset. Hyper-local execution.  
  
**SUMMARY OF ROLE**  
As a BDR (Business Development Rep) you will be trained in all aspects of the products and solutions that we sell to the commercial real estate market. You will then work with the sales team to create new meetings, proposals and then contracts for clients. Your days will consist of training, taking meetings with clients, attending events to network and learn about our industry. Your goal as an BDR is to ultimately be promoted into a business manager. Once a business manager, you will begin to build your own book of business. If you want to learn how to be a successful business development executive and are willing to work hard and learn, this is a great opportunity for you.

* Build and own relationships with marketing decision-makers across all asset classes and sectors in your target markets — this is a relationship-first role.

* Connect with prospects through phone and email with confidence and creativity — and respond to every inbound lead like it matters, because it does.
* Partner with the event production team to shape sponsor-friendly programs that genuinely align with what our clients care about.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and bring fresh, relevant ideas to the table — the best people here think like journalists and sell like entrepreneurs.
* Know your numbers. Understand individual and team KPIs and show up every day with a plan to hit them — then push past them.
* Keep Salesforce updated and accurate — your pipeline is your business and your documentation reflects how seriously you take it.
* Work closely with a high-energy, cross-functional team to drive sponsorship, marketing, and event performance across the board.

### **What are we looking for?**

* **0–1 years of sales or client-facing experience** — internships, campus jobs, and side hustles count. We care about what you’ve done, not just where.
* **Innate hustle, raw intelligence, and infectious enthusiasm** — you’re the person who finds a way, not a reason. You make the room more energetic just by being in it.
* **Entrepreneurial but disciplined** — you think like an owner and execute like a professional. Creative enough to find new angles, organized enough to follow through.
* **A fast learner who stays curious** — we’re constantly bringing new digital and event products to market. You’ll need to understand them, believe in them, and sell them. If you love learning how things work, you’ll thrive here.
* **A proven team player** — athletics, clubs, Greek life, group projects, volunteer work — show us a moment where you elevated the people around you.
* **Hungry to be client-facing** — this role is your launchpad into an externally facing sales career. You should be excited about that, not just open to it.
* **Genuinely curious about commercial real estate, media, and digital marketing** — you don’t need to know the industry cold, but you should want to. Our best people become obsessed with the space they cover.
* **Coachable above all else** — you welcome feedback, act on it fast, and don’t take it personally. The best salespeople in this building got there because they listened.
* **Built for a fast-paced environment** — things move quickly here and priorities shift. You stay focused, adapt without drama, and bring energy on the hard days too.

* 4 or more years of experience in B2B sales and/or B2B sales administration.
* Experience developing customer or distributor relationships that resulted in incremental business.
* Experience in using Salesforce or another Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system.
* Professional proficiency reading, writing, and speaking Spanish.
* Experience using artificial intelligence tools in a business environment.
* Experience with structured cabling, including copper and fiber solutions, and/or enterprise data center environments.
* Bachelor's degree or higher.

For this role, we anticipate paying $70,000 - $85,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Relocation benefits are not provided for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future sponsorship

**Hiring Philosophy**

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here .

**Who We Are**

At Molex, we offer you the opportunity to contribute to the development of electronic solutions that improve people's lives. We use our capabilities to transform the world by creating solutions for technology used in everyday products. From data communications to the home, automotive, industrial, consumer, medical and other markets, our products enable the technology that brings people together.

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

**Our Benefits**

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Operations Coordinator keeps our orders, inventory and shipments moving. You will own the day-to-day path from purchase order to delivered and invoiced, working with customers, distributors, suppliers, co-manufacturers, carriers and our third-party warehouses. It is a hands-on role that combines logistics, order processing, inventory control, customer service and some accounting support.

\*\*Schedule: \*\*Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM. No weekends.

Reports to: Operations Director

\*\*Compensation: \*\*$26 per hour- 40 hour week based on experience, plus benefits

**Key Responsibilities**

Order Processing & Fulfillment (approx. 30%)

* Receive, enter and confirm customer purchase orders from distributors, wholesale accounts and direct customers, including EDI orders.

* Release orders to our third-party warehouses and confirm ship dates and quantities.

* Process and ship daily e-commerce orders (Amazon and other online channels) and stock Amazon FBA inventory.

* Generate and send invoices through EDI and QuickBooks Enterprise; send advance ship notices where required.

* Track open orders to completion and resolve shorts, substitutions, backorders and pricing discrepancies.

Logistics & Transportation (approx. 25%)

* Schedule inbound and outbound freight (LTL and full truckload) with carriers and freight brokers; get quotes and pick the most cost-effective option.

* Book delivery appointments with distributor DCs and arrange customer pickups.

* Coordinate inbound shipments from domestic suppliers and co-manufacturers, plus imported containers, working with our customs broker and freight forwarder on documents and arrival timing.

* Act as the main day-to-day contact for our third-party warehouses (receiving, picking, shipping, inventory reports and billing).

* Prepare and check shipping documents: bills of lading, packing lists, pallet labels and case labels.

* Handle freight claims, damages and carrier delays, and keep customers informed.

Inventory Control (approx. 20%)

* Keep inventory records accurate across several warehouse locations, and reconcile warehouse reports against our systems (QuickBooks and SkuVault).

* Prepare purchase orders to suppliers for approval, then follow up on confirmations and ship dates.

* Track lot codes and shelf life; rotate stock first-expired, first-out (FEFO) and flag slow-moving or aging inventory.

* Support cycle counts, physical inventories and inventory adjustments.

Customer Service (approx. 15%)

* Serve as the first point of contact for customer, distributor and broker questions about orders, status, pricing and product information.

* Answer phone and email questions promptly and professionally.

* Process returns, credits and deductions, working with accounting to resolve them.

* Keep customer setup paperwork up to date (vendor forms, item setup sheets, certificates of insurance, food-safety documents).

Accounting Support & Administration (approx. 10%)

* Enter accounts payable (supplier, freight and warehouse invoices) and accounts receivable in QuickBooks Enterprise.

* Match freight and warehouse bills to shipments before payment.

* Run routine reports (open orders, inventory, shipments, sales) for management.

* Other duties as assigned, including general office support.

Qualifications

Required

* 3 or more years of experience in order processing, logistics coordination, inventory control or customer service in a distribution, manufacturing or consumer products company.

* **Working experience with QuickBooks.**

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills (sorting, filtering, lookups, basic formulas) plus Outlook and Word.

* Very accurate with numbers and data entry.

* Clear, professional written and verbal communication.

* Able to manage many open orders and deadlines at once and stay calm when plans change.

* High school diploma or GED.

Preferred

* Experience in foodservice, grocery or CPG, ideally with broadline distributors such as Sysco, US Foods, DOT Foods or Sygma.

* EDI experience.

* Experience working with third-party (3PL) warehouses and scheduling LTL and truckload freight.

* Experience with Amazon Seller Central / FBA, ShipStation or SkuVault.

* Familiarity with food-safety documentation, lot tracking and shelf-life management.

\*\*\*The Huntington Resource is an Equal Opportunity Employer – All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of the individual’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), marital status, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

We are grateful for the contributions our valued employees make toward the maintenance and effectiveness of the programs. The organization is indebted to and dependent on the diligence and devotion of its employees.

**ABOUT OUR OPERATIONS TEAM**

Become part of the dedicated Operations Team at The Salvation Army! Together we can continue to serve and impact our local community, through the commitment to “Do The Most Good” at our **Anaheim Distribution Center**, which supports the Adult Rehabilitation Program. This is an opportunity to work as team and utilize your skills as a driver, while contributing to the success of our Program and its participants.

* Opportunity for career growth

* Medical, Dental, and Vision

* Ability to operate a motor vehicle

* Work schedules are determined by Management and employee must be flexible to always ensure adequate coverage.

Required

Required

new_jobs.title: TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR
new_jobs.description:
**TEMPORARY SCHOOLS PROGRAM COORDINATOR**

  

Position Type: Temporary, Full-Time (40 hours/week), Non-Exempt  
Employment Period: January–June 2027  
Reports To: Schools Program Manager  
Location: In-person at SFUSD school sites and LYRIC’s Purple House, San Francisco  
Hourly Rate: $30.58/hour (non-negotiable per LYRIC’s equity-based pay model)  
Union Status: Union position (OPEIU Local 29)

ABOUT THE POSITION

LYRIC seeks a thoughtful and experienced Temporary Schools Program Coordinator to deliver school-based support groups for SFUSD students, creating affirming spaces for LGBTQQ+ youth to strengthen positive identity development, self-esteem, personal growth, and peer connection. Serving 120 youth annually, the program offers weekly groups exploring healthy relationships, self-confidence, identity, and navigating school and community systems. Each cohort includes 3–10 students, averaging 5 participants, with sessions lasting up to 60 minutes, typically held in high school Wellness Centers or school-based health centers. The coordinator also connects students with LYRIC’s Purple House programs and supports programming there during spring break and summer break dates within the January–June employment period.

CORE COMPETENCIES

* Youth Development & Engagement: Build on young people’s strengths, center their voices and choices, and support their leadership, independence, and progress toward their goals.

* Equity & Inclusion: Create affirming environments for LGBTQQ+ youth across identities and backgrounds. Practice cultural humility, examine personal biases, and recognize how systemic barriers affect young people’s lives.

* Relationship Building & Collaboration: Build trust with youth, coworkers, and community partners. Coordinate services, share relevant information appropriately, and contribute to shared goals.

* Effective Communication: Listen actively, communicate clearly and respectfully, and address concerns directly and constructively. Adapt communication to different needs and situations.

* Emotional Awareness & Self-Management: Recognize how personal emotions and reactions affect others. Remain grounded during challenging interactions and respond with empathy, professionalism, and a trauma-informed approach.

* Critical Thinking & Sound Judgment: Assess situations, identify appropriate next steps, and recognize when to seek guidance. Respond to safety concerns within established protocols and the scope of the role.

* Professional Integrity & Accountability: Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality, follow through on commitments, and take responsibility for actions. Communicate barriers early and follow organizational policies.

* Program Delivery & Organization: Prepare and deliver purposeful services and activities, manage time and resources responsibly, and complete accurate, timely documentation and follow-up.

* Learning & Adaptability: Seek and apply feedback, build relevant skills, and adjust to changing youth and program needs. Use reflection and experience to improve practice.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Youth Development & Group Facilitation

* Facilitate weekly support groups promoting positive identity development, self-esteem, healthy relationships, personal growth, and peer connection.
* Center youth voices and choices, creating opportunities for leadership and meaningful participation.
* Prepare and adapt age-appropriate curriculum informed by positive youth development, harm reduction, and youth sexual health education.
* Create inclusive, affirming environments that reflect students’ identities and address barriers to participation.
* Provide individual check-ins and basic resource support while maintaining boundaries and supporting youth independence.
* Respond to challenging group dynamics with empathy, self-awareness, and appropriate de-escalation; seek support when needed.

School-to-Community Connections

* Connect students with programs, services, and opportunities at LYRIC’s Purple House.
* Coordinate introductions, referrals, and follow-up with colleagues to help students access services and maintain engagement.
* Support Purple House programming during spring break and summer break dates within the employment period.

Program Planning & Partnerships

* Plan weekly sessions of up to 45 minutes for cohorts of 3–10 students.
* Prepare materials in advance, manage responsibilities across school sites, and use time and resources responsibly.
* Build collaborative relationships with school staff, counselors, Wellness Center staff, and community partners.
* Coordinate schedules, meeting spaces, and student referrals; communicate expectations and changes clearly.
* Participate in student support meetings when appropriate, sharing information within confidentiality requirements and the scope of the role.
* Use student feedback and participation data to improve programming and contribute to the program’s annual goal of serving 120 youth.

Documentation, Accountability & Safety

* Maintain accurate, timely records of participation, activities, referrals, and outcomes in LYRIC’s data systems.
* Contribute to program reports and funder documentation.
* Protect confidential information and follow procedures for storing and sharing records.
* Recognize safety concerns, follow reporting and response protocols, and consult the Schools Program Manager when guidance is needed.
* Follow through on commitments and communicate barriers early.

Teamwork & Professional Growth

* Participate in supervision, team meetings, trainings, and organization-wide events.
* Collaborate across departments and contribute to shared responsibilities.
* Seek and apply feedback, reflect on personal assumptions and reactions, and take responsibility for improvement.
* Adapt to changing school and program needs while communicating about priorities and capacity.
* Support an organized transition of program information and outstanding follow-up at the end of the assignment.

YOU BRING

new_jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**San Francisco, CA · Full-time, hourly · Hybrid (in person 2–3 days/week) · $25/hour to start**

Tag Operations is a growing operations consultancy. We're hiring our first team member: someone who loves data, process and getting the details exactly right. You'll keep our client projects and business development organized, accurate and on time, and you'll work directly with the founder.

This is an entry-level role with a fast track. If you show strong results in your first 6 months, the role grows into client relationship management and co-leading deliverables, with pay increases and a commission or profit-share plan built together along the way.

**What you'll do**

* Enter, clean and organize client data, checking it for errors before anyone else sees it
* Track hours by client and reconcile them weekly
* Monitor and triage the founder's inbox; flag what's urgent or doesn't look right
* Manage calendars: schedule meetings, prep agendas, send follow-ups
* Write and maintain process documentation (SOPs, checklists, templates)
* Keep shared files organized with clear naming and folder structure
* Run CRM admin: keep contacts, deals and next steps current
* Support outreach: build prospect lists, draft messages, track follow-ups

**You might be a fit if you**

* Notice the typo, the duplicate row or the number that doesn't add up — and say something
* Check your work, then check it again
* Ask questions when something is unclear, then keep moving
* Enjoy learning and building systems: spreadsheets, trackers, tidy folders
* Are dependable and responsive; people can count on you
* Handle confidential information with care
* Are comfortable switching between tasks and solving problems as they come up

**Nice to have**

* Experience with a CRM (Pipedrive, HubSpot) or time-tracking/project tools
* Spreadsheet skills beyond the basics (filters, lookups, pivot tables)
* Admin or ops experience at an agency, consultancy or small business

**How we work**

* 40 hours/week, hourly; you'll track your time by project and task
* In person with the founder 2–3 days a week in San Francisco; remote the rest
* Hiring includes a short, practical 45-minute skills exercise

**Pay and benefits**

* $25/hour to start, with reviews at 90 days and 6 months tied to a written growth plan
* 401(k) with a 3% employer match
* Paid sick leave from day one (1 hour per 30 worked; usable after 90 days)

new_jobs.title: Events & Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Zilliz is a fast-growing startup developing the industry’s leading vector database for enterprise-grade AI. Founded by the engineers behind Milvus, the world’s most popular open-source vector database, the company builds next-generation database technologies to help organizations quickly create AI applications. On a mission to democratize AI, Zilliz is committed to simplifying data management for AI applications and making vector databases accessible to every organization.

**About the Role**

We're looking for an Events & Operations Specialist to help plan and execute Zilliz's marketing and community events, while also supporting selected internal operations.

You'll work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Developer Relations teams to coordinate everything from developer meetups and customer events to industry conferences and trade shows. This is a hands-on role that involves working with both internal teams and external partners to keep projects organized and events running smoothly.

We're looking for someone who's organized, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative. You should enjoy working with different people, solving problems as they come up, and finding ways to improve how things get done. Events will be your primary focus, with a smaller portion of the role dedicated to internal operational and administrative support.

### **What You'll Do**

**Events & Marketing Support**

* Coordinate the planning and execution of developer meetups, community gatherings, sales events, conferences, and trade shows, primarily across North America and Europe.
* Manage event logistics, including registration, attendee communications, venue arrangements, vendors, materials, and on-site coordination.
* Work with Marketing, Sales, and DevRel teams to understand event objectives, coordinate resources, and ensure activities are delivered on schedule.
* Maintain event timelines, budgets, and task lists, follow up with stakeholders, and address issues that could affect execution.
* Coordinate with external vendors, venues, speakers, and partners throughout the event planning process.
* Contribute ideas to improve event formats, attendee engagement, and the overall event experience.
* Support post-event activities, including attendee follow-ups, lead coordination, feedback collection, and basic performance reporting.

**Internal Operations & Administrative Support**

* Assist with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks.
* Help coordinate internal meetings, team activities, and other operational needs as they arise.
* Support improvements to internal processes and team coordination where needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

* At least 2 years of relevant professional experience in event marketing, event coordination, operations, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience organizing events or managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities and follow through on commitments.
* A proactive approach to work, with the ability to identify problems, take initiative, and move projects forward with limited supervision.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with experience coordinating across internal teams and working with external vendors or partners.
* Comfortable working in a startup environment where priorities can change and processes may not always be clearly defined.
* A practical, resourceful approach to problem-solving, along with the willingness to contribute new ideas and take on different types of work.
* Willingness to travel domestically and occasionally internationally to support events.

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience with developer meetups, technical community events, or B2B technology conferences.
* Familiarity with developer communities, open-source technologies, AI, or data infrastructure.
* Experience working in a startup or fast-growing technology company.
* Familiarity with event management, project management, or marketing tools.

Zilliz is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. new_jobs.title: Community Manager (San Francisco)
new_jobs.description:
Hey! We’re team Granola We’re building the leading AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings, a product that’s spreading through teams and redefining how knowledge is captured and used. We help teams turn messy call notes into structured insight, so they can spend more time focusing on what’s important and less time on admin.

**Why we care about community**
-------------------------------

When people find Granola, they tend to really love it. Community is how we bring that feeling offline, into a room with other people who feel the same.

We’ve run 100+ events with more than 5,000 people, starting in London, and learnt a lot about what makes people come back.

In SF, we’ve opened an office and run a number of events, experimenting as we go: our GTM Series, a demo night with Linear, a GTM hackathon with Anthropic and more. Now we’re looking for someone to take it beyond the experimental phase and build a well-oiled machine, known as one of the best places in SF for tech community and events.

We don’t measure community in signups. It’s brand marketing, and it’s how we show people what Granola is like in person.

### **Our goal**

Make Granola one of the best AI-native, human brands for professionals.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

You’ll own generating event ideas and community initiatives and the execution those ideas:

* Come up with event and community ideas, and think hard about what makes an event special
* Curate the guest list so a great group of people show up
* Own all comms with speakers, partners and guests
* Run logistics like a station master, so everything leaves on time
* Own the marketing for every event, from the copy to the socials, so the room is full
* Work closely with our brand and events teams in London, who hold the bar on how Granola shows up
* Pitch in on big product launches when we need all hands
* Build relationships with the top accelerators and VCs in the Bay (e.g. YC, Neo, HF0, SPC). Be there when new cohorts land, so Granola is the first tool founders reach for on day one

**How you’ll know it’s working**
--------------------------------

* Within 6 months, people in SF say Granola puts on some of the best tech events in the city
* Before that:

  + Your events fill up are oversubscribed with the relevant folks for each event
  + Great event and community ideas keep coming
  + You own and run logistics like clockwork

**About you**
-------------

**Your background**

* 5+ years in community and events, venture, startup ecosystems or partnerships
* A track record of running great events for a tech audience consistently
* Comfortable talking to execs and founders

**Bonus points**

* A strong network in Bay Area tech, with relationships across founders, accelerators or VCs

**As a person, you**

* **Work autonomously.** You set direction together with Shre and the team, then run with it. Take feedback well - you get curious, adjust quickly, and show the change in your next piece of work
* **Sweat the details.** For every event, you think about the one thing that will make people remember it and feel special. You treat the attendee experience like a user flow: from the moment someone arrives outside our office, to checking in, to knowing where the bathroom is before they have to ask
* **Get startups and tech.** You’re always reading, listening and learning about the fastest-growing startups, founders and operators, and you know what founders care about
* **Have great judgment.** You come up with original ideas and have the instincts to know what’s right for Granola’s brand. Our bar is high, and you’re always open to learning how to meet it
* **Roll up your sleeves.** This is a founding community role. You’re as comfortable emailing a unicorn founder as you are Ubering to a restaurant yourself to pick up pizza boxes if DoorDash is horrendously late to make sure everyone’s fed. No task is beneath you
* **Love being around people.** You get energy from meeting people, can work a crowd, and can say no politely but firmly
* **Embody the core Granola traits:** hardworking, kind and incredibly ambitious

**Compensation**
----------------

Base salary: $150,000–$180,000, depending on experience, plus equity

We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart’s demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together.

Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable, and equity.

Lastly, we think amazing talent comes from all kinds of life journeys and experiences. If what is written above speaks to you, whether you look like a fit on paper or not, please reach out.

Compensation Range: $150K - $180K

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, West
new_jobs.description:
**Role Overview**
=================

Cogent is building autonomous cyber defense with AI agents that help security teams move from finding risk to actually fixing it. Field is already a major pipeline engine for us, and we are hiring a Field Marketing Manager to help scale that motion with sharp execution, creativity, and operating leverage.

This role sits within the Demand Generation arm of Growth and partners closely with Sales, SDR, Partnerships, Product Marketing, and RevOps. The mandate is to help turn regional programs, executive events, partner activations, and big industry moments into qualified meetings, pipeline, and stronger account relationships.

This is a hands-on execution role with real leverage. In the first few months, you will help build the field marketing operating system: event calendar, target-account planning, pre/post-event workflows, rep and partner coordination, follow-up SLAs, AI-powered logistics tracking, and reporting that shows which programs create real pipeline.

**Ownership Areas**
===================

**Field Strategy and Program Planning**
---------------------------------------

* Help build regional and account-based field plans aligned to pipeline targets, priority accounts, sales territories, and partner opportunities.
* Support the right mix of executive roundtables, dinners, roadshows, conferences, partner activations, customer/prospect events, and VIP experiences.
* Partner with Demand Gen and Sales to connect field programs to digital, content, outbound, and nurture so programs are amplified before and after the event.
* Maintain a field calendar, program briefs, account lists, meeting goals, budgets, and success metrics.

**Event Execution and Experience**
----------------------------------

* Run end-to-end execution for assigned field programs: planning, logistics, venues/vendors, invitations, on-site experience, materials, speaker coordination, and follow-up.
* Make every event feel high-quality, intentional, and connected to the Cogent brand.
* Coordinate tightly with AEs, SDRs, Partnerships, and leadership so target accounts are invited, followed up with, and converted into meetings and opportunities.
* Help build repeatable playbooks, workflows, and AI-assisted tracking systems so we can manage logistics, tasks, vendors, follow-up, and reporting across more programs without reinventing the process every time.

**Pipeline Impact and Partner Activation**
------------------------------------------

* Track event performance across registration, attendance, target-account engagement, meetings, SQLs, pipeline, deal acceleration, and ROI.
* Partner with RevOps to keep attribution, campaign membership, follow-up, and pipeline reporting clean.
* Support co-marketing and channel activations with partners, including regional programs, deal-registration follow-up, spiffs, and better-together stories.
* Use AI and automation to improve event research, targeting, personalized outreach, logistics tracking, task management, post-event follow-up, recap assets, and reporting.

**What We Are Looking For**
===========================

* 2-4+ years in field marketing, event marketing, partner marketing, demand generation, or marketing/program operations in B2B SaaS or technology; cybersecurity interest or experience is a plus.
* Experience supporting or running events, webinars, field programs, or partner activations tied to pipeline goals.
* Strong project manager who can keep logistics, vendors, budgets, calendars, stakeholders, and follow-up moving.
* Comfortable working directly with Sales and SDR teams on target accounts, invite lists, event conversion, and follow-up.
* Good taste for customer/prospect experience and brand quality; detail-oriented enough to make programs feel polished.

**About the Role**

Fabuwood is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Specialist to own and execute the company's digital marketing programs across CRM and email, paid media and other digital channels.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move comfortably between strategy, execution, coordination, and analysis. The Digital Marketing Specialist will manage day-to-day CRM and email activity, oversee paid advertising, coordinate with internal teams and external partners, and continuously improve performance across the digital customer journey.

The role reports to the Digital Marketing Manager and owns the respective digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard. Success requires strong follow-through, reliable reporting, and the ability to turn performance data into clear recommendations and next steps.

***Schedule: M-Th 8:00AM-5:00PM. F 8:00AM-12:00PM***

**Key Responsibilities**

CRM & Email Marketing

* Own the day-to-day management and execution of Fabuwood's CRM and email marketing program in HubSpot.
* Plan, build, test, schedule, and deploy email campaigns, including newsletters, product communications, promotions, event follow-up, onboarding, nurture, and re-engagement programs.
* Manage audience segmentation, lists, workflows, automation, personalization, lead routing, and lifecycle stages to ensure communications are relevant and timely.
* Monitor deliverability, engagement, conversions, list health, and campaign performance; use testing and analysis to continuously improve results.

Paid Media

* Lead the day-to-day management and oversight of paid digital media, whether executed internally or through agency and vendor partners.
* Support campaign strategy, audience targeting, budgets, creative requirements, landing pages, tracking, optimization, and reporting across channels such as Google, Meta, YouTube, display, and other relevant platforms.
* Review performance regularly and make recommendations to improve efficiency, lead quality, conversion, and return on marketing investment.

Metrics, Scorecard & Optimization

* Own the digital marketing metrics on Fabuwood's scorecard, including the accuracy, timeliness, definitions, targets, and reporting cadence for each assigned metric.
* Maintain dashboards and recurring reports covering accountable activity.
* Analyze performance by audience, campaign, channel, and funnel stage to identify trends, risks, gaps, and opportunities.
* Translate data into clear insights, recommendations, and action plans for the Digital Marketing Manager and broader marketing team.
* Work with internal stakeholders and partners to improve tracking, attribution, data quality, and reporting consistency.

Planning & Cross-Functional Execution

* Develop digital channel plans that support product launches, dealer initiatives, A+D programs, events, brand campaigns, and lead-generation goals.
* Manage digital marketing timelines, priorities, budgets, vendors, and deliverables, escalating risks or performance concerns when needed.
* Collaborate closely with creative, content, project management, sales, IT, and other teams to keep campaigns aligned and moving forward.
* Stay current on platform changes, digital best practices, privacy requirements, and emerging opportunities relevant to Fabuwood's audiences.

**ABOUT PROCURE ANALYTICS**

Procure Analytics (PA) is the leading tech-enabled group purchasing organization for MRO, Packaging, and Freight, leveraging $2.5B+ in buying power to deliver up-front and ongoing savings for 1,000+ member companies ranging from mid-size manufacturers to Fortune 500 corporations. Headquartered in Atlanta and owned by Genstar Capital, PA is in an aggressive growth phase with a rapidly expanding Packaging program.

PA serves as a strategic extension of our members' procurement organizations — driving adoption, managing supplier relationships, and delivering measurable, documented value at scale.

**The Packaging Program Today:** The Packaging program is one of PA's fastest-growing categories. With strong momentum and interest from our membership, we are building the team to ensure we stay ahead of the curve and exceed member expectations.

**THE ROLE**

As a Packaging Member Advisor, you will own a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts spanning a broad range of industries. Your members will range from independent companies to private equity-backed organizations and consulting relationships, reflecting the diversity of PA's membership base. You will serve as the primary point of contact for your members and a key driver of program adoption, realized value and impactful business outcomes. You will report to the Director of Packaging & Logistics and work in close partnership with others on the Packaging & Logistics team.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Manage a defined portfolio of packaging member accounts with full accountability for engagement, retention, and delivered value.
* Develop deep knowledge of each member's organization structure, procurement contacts, site operations, packaging spend profile, and strategic priorities.
* Maintain a 3-wide, 3-deep relationship architecture — building relationships across procurement, operations, and finance at C-suite, director, and site manager levels.
* Lead standardized Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) covering spend consolidated, savings delivered, opportunities identified, and forward-looking member needs.
* Identify and execute packaging optimization opportunities with our supplier partners, including SKU consolidation, packaging rationalization, vendor switching, and adoption tracking.
* Build strong working relationships with PA's packaging supplier partners to identify member-specific optimization levers.
* Utilize technology tools including PowerBI, Salesforce, Trumpet, AI, and PA proprietary software to document member interactions, track opportunity pipelines, and highlight risks.
* Support new member onboarding by participating in implementation handoffs and ensuring a seamless transition from the implementation process.

Requirements:

**Experience & Background**

* 3–5 years of experience in packaging, logistics, or supply chain account management — you have owned a book of business and been accountable for results.
* Direct experience working with or selling into manufacturing, industrial, or CPG companies; you understand how procurement decisions are made at complex organizations.
* Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder environments — you can operate effectively at the C-suite level and the site floor with equal ease.
* Demonstrated track record of building proactive client relationships, not reactive ones; you have examples of identifying and acting on opportunities before customers asked.

* Company subsidized medical, dental, and vision coverage

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About Gallagher Security**

Gallagher Security is a global technology leader trusted by organizations to protect people, assets, and operations in complex environments. We’re looking for an energetic Sales Development Representative who enjoys connecting with prospective customers, generating demand, and creating opportunities that support our continued growth.

**The Opportunity**

As an SDR, you will engage in our lead generation strategy that focuses on research, outreach, prospecting, outbound demand generation, inbound, and lead qualification via all our social media and market intelligence platforms. This position will help turn leads into qualified opportunities by partnering with marketing and sales to create and execute on program and outbound lead generation campaigns. This will be accomplished by conducting a mix of communication tactics such as email and outbound calls, with the ultimate goal of uncovering new or existing sales leads as well as identifying and generating sales opportunities through both inbound and outbound calling activities.

Reporting to the Sales Development Team Lead, you’ll work cross functionally with sales, marketing, and engineering, and as one of the first people a prospect speaks with, you’ll set the tone for the sales cycle that follows.

This is a hybrid role, with an expected 2–3 days per week in our Canton office and the remainder working from home. Travel is minimal.

**What You’ll Do**

* Follow up on inbound marketing leads and qualify interest through phone and email conversations, giving prospects the right information at the right time.

* Build target prospect lists, penetrate key accounts, and cold call prospects sourced from a range of channels.

* Profile strategic accounts, identify key decision makers, and research business requirements to start the sales cycle.

* Run discovery and qualification calls and deliver high level, solution oriented presentations on Gallagher products and services.

* Understand each prospect’s needs and tailor your outreach to suit.

* Nurture leads until they’re ready to speak with a Business Development Manager or Regional Sales Manager, then set appointments, schedule on-site demos, and hand off qualified opportunities.

* Drive attendance at webinars and live seminars and set meetings for conferences.

* Keep accurate prospect, activity, and lead qualification records in our CRM to ensure strong follow through.

* Share feedback and new ideas to continually improve our sales development process.

* Build your knowledge of the access control, perimeter protection, and intrusion detection markets, and clearly articulate the value Gallagher Security brings.

* Shadow Business Development Managers and, when needed, travel with Outside Sales to meet in-region partners and end users.

**What You’ll Bring**

You’re a confident, energetic communicator who enjoys starting conversations, thinks outside the box, and brings real tenacity to reaching your goals.

* 2+ years of successful experience in inside sales, demand generation, telemarketing, and/or customer service.

* A four year college degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent experience; a bachelor’s degree in business or a related area is preferred.

* Demonstrated success in prospecting and experience using CRM systems; experience with sales outreach platforms is a plus.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, strong active listening, emotional intelligence, and a positive, energetic phone presence.

* The ability to explain complex issues clearly and hold relaxed but informative two way conversations with prospects.

* The ability to manage multiple requests and priorities at once while achieving goals for your territory or accounts.

* A self-motivated approach and sense of urgency. You act without waiting to be told and work well under pressure.

* A team player mindset, with the flexibility to work independently and collaborate with a distributed sales team in a fast paced, changing environment.

* High integrity, a strong work ethic, and a commitment to building a successful company.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**What We Offer**

* Career development opportunities, including the chance to learn from experienced sales professionals and build skills for future advancement.

* A collaborative, cross functional environment where your ideas and contributions can help improve our sales approach.

* The opportunity to represent a respected global security technology company and contribute directly to regional growth.

**Apply Now**

If you’re ready to build relationships, generate demand, and help create new opportunities for Gallagher Security, apply today.

new_jobs.title: Community Outreach Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Marketing Services | Chicago, IL | Full-Time | Local Travel Required**

**Pay Range: $65,000 – $80,000 annually, commensurate with experience**

**Join us — and do work that matters.**

We're a passionate team of change-makers, diverse thinkers, and problem-solvers. Our purpose: ensuring full access to quality living and championing the power of inclusivity. We proudly serve over 7,000 individuals with disabilities and behavioral health challenges, including those who are Deaf, DeafBlind, and Hard of Hearing.

If you're not looking for just any job — if you're ready to build a career where your work directly supports that mission — Anixter Center is the place for you.

**About the Role**

As our Community Outreach Manager, you'll be the face of Anixter Center to the schools and agencies that support young people and adults with IDD and mental health needs. You'll build and sustain a robust referral network that connects individuals and families to our transition and community-based services, and you'll make sure every referral ends in a successful connection. You'll be the primary point of contact for Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, Integrated Community Supports agencies (ISCs), Community Service Organizations (CSOs), and Community Alternative Unlimited units (CAUs) across Chicagoland, and you'll partner closely with Intake, Case Management, program staff, and Marketing/Communications.

This is a full-time, exempt role based in Chicago, with regular local travel throughout the Chicagoland area. A flexible schedule is required, which may include evenings and weekends as necessary.

**What You'll Do**

* Build and grow a referral pipeline by developing strong, lasting relationships with Special Education Teachers, Transition Schools, ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs.
* Conduct regular outreach through site visits, presentations, and one-on-one meetings with school staff, coordinators, and case managers.
* Represent Anixter Center at IEP/transition planning meetings, school fairs, community events, and networking functions to raise awareness of our programs.
* Serve as a go-to resource on our transition, IDD, mental health, and Deaf/DeafBlind/Hard of Hearing services, helping partners understand eligibility, intake, and program fit.
* Set up and maintain clear referral pathways with partners, documenting how to refer, who to contact, and what to expect at each step.
* Track every referral from first contact to enrollment in our CRM, and follow up with partners and families to close the loop. Work with Intake, Case Management, and program staff to make each handoff smooth.
* Develop outreach materials with Marketing/Communications, monitor referral trends and outcomes, and share what you learn about gaps, underserved communities, and new partnership opportunities with leadership.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Education, Human Services, Public Health, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (preferred).
* 2+ years of experience in community outreach, community development, referral or care coordination, case management, special education, or transition services (preferred).
* Working knowledge of the IDD and/or mental health service systems in Illinois, including ISCs, CSOs, and CAUs, and familiarity with PUNS (Prioritization of Urgency of Need for Services) and the IEP/transition planning process.
* Excellent relationship-building, networking, and communication skills, with the confidence to engage school administrators, educators, and agency partners, and strong organizational skills with a CRM or referral-tracking database.
* A valid driver's license, willingness to travel locally throughout Chicagoland, and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as necessary.
* An existing network in Chicagoland special education, transition schools, or DHS/DRS-affiliated service coordination agencies; experience working with individuals who are Deaf, DeafBlind, or Hard of Hearing (ASL a plus); and nonprofit, healthcare, or education-adjacent partnerships experience are all a plus.
* A genuine commitment to nonprofit, mission-driven work.

**Benefits**

Anixter Center offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, and generous paid time off and holidays.

**Why Anixter Center**

You'll join a collaborative, mission-driven team committed to inclusion and accessibility, where relationships and follow-through translate directly into people getting the right supports at the right time. We offer a mission you can feel good about and the chance to be the connection between families and the services they need.

*Anixter Center is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing people with disabilities.*

**Ready to make an impact? Apply today with your resume and a cover letter describing your experience building partnerships or referral networks and your interest in our mission.**
